articleTitle: Simulation of Marketing Risk Prediction Model Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, marketing is developing towards intelligence. On the one hand, social network based on Internet technology has become an important platform for marketing, which has attracted wide attention from industry and academia. On the other hand, the Internet makes information and data more transparent, and it can provide support for marketing decisions based on the mining and analysis of a large number of data. During the marketing period, enterprises will be affected by many different factors, which will also restrict the development of enterprise marketing work. In order to improve the advantages of enterprises in market competition, reasonable measures should be taken to complete the corresponding prediction and control. In this paper, factor indicators are extracted through factor analysis, and then K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the operation data of online loan platform based on the change of factor indicators. Finally, the risk of online loan platform is divided through the clustering results. In the process of estimating and calculating the parameters of the prediction model, a set of relatively optimal prediction parameters is determined by selecting an error criterion. Finally, the obtained model is verified and analyzed. The experimental results show that the linear prediction method can be used to establish the marketing prediction model, and the established prediction model has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Design of Power Environment Monitoring System for Central Computer Room Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional power environment monitoring system of the central computer room, the power environment monitoring system of the central computer room based on IoT (Internet of Things) technology can realize that users do not need to build a monitoring center system platform, which is convenient for unified management. In this paper, a set of power environment monitoring system for central computer room based on IoT technology is designed, which mainly consists of two parts: monitoring platform and monitoring unit. Among them, the monitoring unit and the computer room monitoring platform are connected by Internet technology. Each independent computer room forms a complete set of local monitoring sites. The system administrator can remotely monitor the computer room environment by using the Web browser, which greatly improves the flexibility and convenience of background monitoring operation. The system mainly includes six functional modules, namely, power and computer room environment monitoring, comprehensive video monitoring, alarm management, historical data management, report management and system management. The function test and performance test results of the system show that the functions of each part meet the design requirements, and the system has a fast response speed, and there is no false alarm, which meets the actual use conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Reconstruction Algorithm of Building Surface Model Based on Geometric Feature Constraint
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Image-based model reconstruction technology uses the information of the image itself to restore the corresponding three-dimensional model. Compared with the traditional way of building 3D model, the image model reconstruction method has the characteristics of fast speed, short period and strong realism. With the rapid development of computer technology, image-based model reconstruction technology has attracted more and more attention. The research on Image-based building model reconstruction technology has always been an important research topic in the field of computer vision, which can be used in the application fields of digital city, ancient building restoration, virtual reality and so on. The expression and processing of various 3D information in urban environment has become increasingly urgent. It is necessary to establish a 3D city model system with management function and operation mechanism to manage and organize a large number of 3 D data Building point cloud surface reconstruction has a wide application prospect in the fields of high-precision urban surveying and mapping, virtual reality and so on. Due to the changeable geometry of buildings, reconstruction algorithms generally have the problems of slow calculation rate, low fitting accuracy and incomplete model structure. Taking the single building as the research object, this paper proposes a single building point cloud surface reconstruction algorithm based on weighted constraints, which fully considers the contribution of data to structure fitting in the process of surface initialization.

articleTitle: Research on LID Technique Based on TFN-AHP Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, there is a lack of effective and systematic evaluation means for the development of vegetation treatment network to select on-site storm water management schemes (LID). Aiming at this problem, this project intends to use the triangular fuzzy number analytic Hierarchy Process (TFN-AHP) on the basis of existing studies to construct a set of evaluation methods applicable to the on-site rainwater management measures combination scheme. Firstly, a single sponge city vegetation treatment network was established to conduct a comprehensive evaluation system on site. Firstly, a single sponge urban plant treatment network was constructed and its rainwater management measures were compared in the field. The AHP method is used to construct a set of multi-level rainwater management scheme based on vegetation treatment network to carry on the multi-level evaluation of on-site rainwater management scheme. The triangular fuzzy number was used to construct the evaluation matrix to obtain the weights of evaluation factors at each level, and then a planting treated network was obtained to study the combination of onsite rainwater management measures. And a concrete “sponge” project as the background of the empirical study of the implementation effect of the project. The research results can lay a foundation for the practical application of on-site rainwater management combination measures using the sponge city vegetation treatment network in the future.

Author Keywords: Vegetation treatment network for on-site rainwater management measures

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Machine Learning in Orderly Charging Demand Prediction and Scheduling Optimization of Charging Piles
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Electric vehicles are gaining popularity among consumers and governments due to their environmentally friendly nature, efficiency, and energy-saving capabilities. With the popularity of electric vehicles, charging piles, as their important supporting facilities, are also facing huge market demand. However, there is currently a mismatch between the number and distribution of charging piles and the charging needs of electric vehicles, which has led to problems such as uneven utilization of charging piles, long waiting times for charging, and excessive load on the power grid. These problems not only affect the travel experience and satisfaction of electric vehicle users, but also pose security and stability challenges to the power system. Therefore, how to effectively predict and optimize the orderly charging needs of charging piles has become an urgent problem to be solved. In order to solve this problem, this paper studies the application of machine learning in the orderly charging demand prediction and scheduling optimization of charging piles. Machine learning is a technology that enables artificial intelligence and automated decision-making through data analysis and model building. In the field of intelligent transportation, machine learning has broad application prospects and can help improve transportation efficiency, safety, and environmental friendliness. This article proposes a solution based on the ensemble learning algorithm BPNB model. By combining the Adaboost algorithm with the BP neural network, this model addresses the limitations of the BP neural network. The BPNB model is a comprehensive learning approach that integrates the Adaboost algorithm and BP neural network algorithm, enhancing the generalization capability and stability of the BP neural network. The study presented in this article introduces a fresh perspective and methodology for the application of machine learning in intelligent transportation. Furthermore, it offers an effective solution to the challenges of predicting orderly charging demand and optimizing the dispatch of charging piles.

articleTitle: Research on Real Estate Price Analysis and Prediction Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s market economy and the continuous rise of the real estate industry, at present, the real estate industry has become one of the most important industries in the pillar industries of the national economy, so the rise and fall of the real estate industry is directly related to individual, collective and even national interests. For the real estate market, the most obvious and important reflection is the price of real estate. The rise and fall of house prices is a rather complicated economic topic, and many factors such as society and economy will have a great influence on the development of real estate, so the relationship between the price of real estate and the economic factors that affect its change is difficult to be reflected by precise mathematical language. In particular, as the most sensitive index in the real estate market, the change law of the real estate market price is different from that of the general commodity price, and will affect the prices of other commodities. In addition to some necessary national policies and measures, we should also reasonably predict and analyze the real estate price, which can help the relevant government departments to locate the land auction price; Secondly, it can also effectively help real estate developers budget the profits and benefits of the real estate; Finally, it can help home buyers understand the normal real estate market price.

articleTitle: Design of Real Estate Enterprise Value Evaluation Model Based on BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the development of urbanization, China’s real estate market has developed rapidly, and a large number of transactions such as consumption and investment have appeared. Among them, residential real estate is a hot spot in the real estate market, accounting for the largest proportion of development investment. Because the real estate industry is a capital-intensive enterprise, there are some problems, such as favoring large-scale development, only focusing on profit growth, excessive equity financing, etc., while the traditional value evaluation method ignores the role of equity capital cost and cannot truly reflect the operating performance and value creation ability of real estate enterprises. However, in the evaluation of real estate listed companies, the applicability of methods, the selection of specific methods and the specific application of models need further study. Secondly, based on the shortcomings of traditional methods, this paper introduces the basic idea of neural network into real estate evaluation, and analyzes the feasibility and advantages of BP neural network (BPNN) in real estate evaluation. Then, based on the theoretical methods in the previous two chapters, the influencing factors of real estate prices were comprehensively analyzed, and an indicator system of influencing factors of residential real estate prices was constructed. The indicators were quantified, standardized, and trended. The importance of the indicators was ranked using random forest theory, reducing the number of indicators, and optimizing the indicator system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Temporal and Spatial Characteristics of Public Bicycle System Based on Shared Bicycle Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the acceleration of modernization, the congestion and environmental pollution caused by the surge of urban road traffic has become one of the important factors affecting people’s happiness index. As a typical product of “internet plus” era, bike-sharing has been popularized and widely concerned by the public. It is consistent with the five development concepts of innovation, coordination, green, openness and sharing. Compared with public bicycles, which need to be borrowed and returned at fixed stations, no pile makes bike-sharing have unique advantages of flexibility and convenience. However, with the rapid expansion of bike-sharing, a series of problems have emerged. Illegal ownership, disorderly parking, intentional destruction and other order problems, as well as problems such as low-end service, traffic chaos, capital security and so on also emerge from time to time. In order to improve the urban transportation service network system, shared bicycles were born. We can’t simply equate shared bicycles with traditional rental products, but should recognize that their essence is quasi public goods that provide short-distance travel services. Market failure leads to the fact that the market, as a single subject, cannot completely avoid the negative externalities brought by sharing bicycles. Compared with the traditional fixed pile public bicycle, the Internet rental bicycle enterprises in the exploration and development period have less operation experience, resulting in the lack of corresponding theoretical guidance for system operation and maintenance scheduling management, which restricts the healthy and orderly development of the system.

articleTitle: Design and Development of inclusive finance Network Security System Model Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As an extension of traditional financial activities in the modern high-tech field, network finance realizes the safe and quick connection between financial institutions and customers through personal computers, communication terminals or other intelligent devices with the help of developed internet and communication technologies, thus facilitating customers to obtain economic and financial information in time, enjoy online financial services and carry out online financial transactions. During the evaluation of computer network security, some traditional assessment methods not only have the problems of low assessment accuracy and insufficient internal correlation research, but also have integrity problems. The interconnection of various factors adds complexity to the safety assessment process, rendering it a more challenging endeavor. In this article, a network security assessment algorithm of inclusive finance based on BP neural network is proposed, so as to create a network security assessment system with detection methods and risk assessment to ensure the security of financial network information. In the simulation results of network security assessment in inclusive finance, it can be seen that this model can get 94.7% recall and 96.8% accuracy rate, and its results are better than the compared model. The network security of financial industry has the characteristics of comprehensiveness, high technology and development, and the maintenance of network security should follow these characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security System Under the Background of New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the four main sources of threats to the power system network security based on the power system network environment. In this paper, a set of power system security system overall design and solutions are given accordingly. The DSM structure of the scheme is divided into low-level and high-level. The low-level provides encrypted channels, and adopts the method of mixing RSA and Rabin encryption; The central AC Agent is used to complete the registration, authority verification, and draft revision of each Agent. Through theoretical analysis and practice, it is proved that the scheme satisfies the requirements of security and real-time performance in the computer network of power system based on multi-agent.

articleTitle: Research on Real Estate Sales Trend Prediction Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The sales price index of real estate is an effective tool to guide industry activities and market research, but the accuracy of prediction has always been paid more attention by people. With the continuous development of the real estate industry, the amount of data is getting larger and larger. Applying data mining technology to the real estate industry, processing and analyzing the sales data can truly reflect the value of the data. In this paper, taking the real estate data of a city in Jiangsu Province as an example, the quantitative research shows the modeling process. Based on ARMA model and the weighted least square method, the model is improved. Because the real estate market is a highly complex nonlinear system, the accurate description of the complex feature of house price trend is becoming more and more important. Artificial neural network is a new interdisciplinary subject. In recent years, it has been more and more applied to the prediction of practical problems, showing its broad application prospects. In particular, artificial neural network has great potential to predict the future behavior of nonlinear systems. BP neural network is applied to the real estate market monitoring and early warning system; This paper forecasts and monitors the change trend of the real estate market, and puts forward the corresponding early warning barriers of the real estate market, so as to provide a more scientific basis for the control of the urban real estate market.

articleTitle: Construction of Family Financial Risk Management System Based on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Family financial risk mainly includes two aspects: personal investment risk and personal borrowing financial risk. According to the general classification of risks, it can be divided into static risks and dynamic risks. With the increasing popularity of AI (artificial intelligence) and big data, both of them have a great impact on family finance. This paper builds a family financial risk management system based on AI and big data analysis. Under the condition of sustainable economic and technological development, applying big data and AI to financial management is the mainstream trend in the future development of families. The framework of family financial risk management system established in this paper combines SVM (Support vector machine) and KNN (KNearest-Neighbor) algorithm in a certain form, and takes a series of financial indicators and big data indicators as the input of SVM, and whether the family has been specially treated as the output, constructs the SVM model and uses the support vector function for regression. The research results show that the accuracy of the improved model algorithm is improved by $11.26 \%$ compared with that before the improvement, and the improvement range is great. Reasonable and effective supervision mechanisms and means should be adopted to gradually increase the coverage and scope of supervision, so as to reduce family financial risks.

articleTitle: Simulation of Logistics Real Time Data Processing and Prediction Model Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the stage of logistics distribution, customers’ needs often become uncertain due to various factors, which brings certain challenges to route planning. In this article, stochastic process theory and decision tree algorithm are used to optimize the distribution path of cold chain, and different path schemes are evaluated and predicted by system simulation theory. Through comparative analysis, it is found that the algorithm has obvious advantages in improving the optimal path matching and traffic flow prediction accuracy. Compared with the traditional algorithm, this algorithm can better deal with the complexity and uncertainty in the stage of cold chain distribution, thus improving the management efficiency of cold chain. Most users have a positive attitude towards the application effect of the algorithm in cold chain optimization and management, and think that the system can improve management efficiency, optimize path effect, reduce costs, and improve the satisfaction of logistics services. Logistics management system (LMS) based on logistics real-time data processing and forecasting model has obvious advantages in cold chain optimization and management, and has high application value and development prospect.

articleTitle: Design of English Practice Diagnosis System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: More and more people choose to test their learning level of a discipline through the online practice system, hoping that the system can evaluate the real score and provide cognitive diagnosis information, so as to promote the improvement and development of individuals in the discipline. However, as far as English subjects are concerned, the vast majority of English online practice systems on the market have not undergone detailed demand investigation and analysis, nor have scientific and systematic teaching theories as support, resulting in the lack of good interactivity and diagnostics, and can not well assist and promote daily English teaching activities. Therefore, this paper starts from demand analysis from the three perspectives of system module design and deep learning theory construction, this paper provides a theoretical support scheme for the construction of English diagnostic practice system.

articleTitle: Design Simulation of Authenticity Effect of Artistic Design Image Based on 3D Virtual Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The main component of modern graphic design art is visual communication technology, which follows the footsteps of the world’s development from industrialization to informatization. At the moment, traditional graphic design can no longer provide designers with matching design materials. For this reason, a new graphic design method is needed. To address this, present an innovative graphic design technique utilizing 3D virtual vision technology. In a specified development environment, users employ a mouse to sketch manually, creating a stroke based on the acquired sequence of ordered points. The denoising processing of the hand-drawn strokes is completed by the smoothing denoising method, and the hand-drawn strokes are fitted by the quadratic spline curve. On this basis, three-dimensional virtual modeling is employed to transform hand-drawn strokes into a graphic design. Following the creation of a three-dimensional model for the design work, a color rendering method is applied to enhance visual appeal. Experimental findings demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in achieving 3D virtual modeling through hand-drawn strokes, resulting in more realistic renderings that align with designer requirements. This facilitates designers in accurately conveying their design intentions.

articleTitle: Research on Building Effect Design System Based on Computer 3D Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this paper, 3D image data obtained by Autodesk Map 3D flatbed scanning system was used to automatically extract point cloud data and conduct point cloud modeling. Firstly, this paper proposes a contour rendering method based on elevation cloud image of data points to extract control points from the whole cloud image region. Then this paper uses the OpenGL graphics library provides rich graphics program interface. According to the principle of minimum distance and maximum Angle, a triangulation irregular network (TIN) model is established. Then, the elevation of data points and color RGB values are corresponded one by one to generate the elevation cloud map of data points. The experimental simulation analysis shows that the application of this method expands the search range of control points and increases the number of control points. In this way, the linearity of the contour map is better and more consistent with the actual terrain.

articleTitle: Simulation of Data Fusion Model of Power Grid Geographic Information System Based on Image Processing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Because the influence of GIS (Geographic Information System) is mostly from satellite images, and the images collected by satellite sensor system are restricted and influenced by the platform, the position and angle of the sun and other conditions, it will show some phenomena such as fuzziness, distortion, distortion and speckle noise, which will reduce the image quality to a certain extent, so the application of image processing technology is essential. Based on this, this paper designs a GIS data fusion model of power grid based on image processing algorithm according to the differences of digital images, spaces and general attribute structures. Using binary segmentation method can complete image segmentation in power grid GIS platform. ICP (Iterative Closest Point) algorithm is used to match DEM (Digital Elevation Model) with 3D GIS. Through repeated iteration, the transformation matrix gradually approaches the real value, thus realizing registration. The research results show that the results can be obtained directly by using DEM and GIS data, and there is no frequent and time-consuming conversion, so the data fusion method can be used to realize the overall integration of GIS and DEM. When DEM data is registered with 3D GIS, the rotation matrix and translation vector obtained from registration can be used to realize the updating of 3D GIS by DEM, which proves the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Vehicle-mounted Methanol Reforming Hydrogen Fuel Cell Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Fuel cells can convert chemical energy stored in fuel into electric energy efficiently and environmentally friendly, and hydrogen is the best fuel for fuel cells. At present, large companies related to automobiles and energy in developed countries are accelerating the development of fuel cells. Using on-board methanol reforming to produce hydrogen is one of the solutions to the problems existing in hydrogen production, transportation, distribution and hydrogenation of fuel cell vehicles. In this paper, based on the modeling idea of combining mechanism with experience, a complete fuel cell model using methanol reforming to produce hydrogen is built. After the simulation test, the simulation results show that the output speed of the motor varies with the working conditions, and the speed of the motor is small under the urban cycle working conditions, but the driving scene is complex, and there are many acceleration and deceleration situations. Compared with the urban working conditions, the speed of the vehicle is large under the high-speed working conditions, and there is usually no sudden acceleration or deceleration. Integrating hydrogen production with fuel cell, and making hydrogen raw materials easily available and transported, can solve the current promotion problem of pure hydrogen fuel cell. At present, methanol reforming hydrogen production technology can solve the problem of on-board hydrogen production.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Analysis of Learning Information in Art Design Education Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Information technology has increasingly penetrated into all aspects of social economy and life. The popularization of the Internet has greatly promoted the development of online education, making it possible for education to transcend geographical and time constraints, and making it possible to popularize social education and lifelong education. Agent is an emerging technology in the field of artificial intelligence and computer software. This article proposes an agent-based intelligent analysis algorithm for art design education learning information, and implements a system prototype that uses the characteristics of the agent to dynamically acquire art design education learning and use the knowledge base to analyze the information of art design education learners, so as to realize automatic guidance to users. It not only has strong interactivity, but can also be migrated in the network to facilitate the collection of resource information. Third, it can compare the rights description information during the migration process, realize the control of the use rights of resources, and provide a certain security guarantee for the resource sharing of distributed resource services.

articleTitle: Biomass Distribution Characteristics of Picea Schrenkiana Var.Tianschanica By Integrating Ordinary Kriging and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Forest biomass modeling is the current mainstream forest biomass measurement method, and is also one of the hot issues in modern forestry scientific research and production practice. In this study, the biomass of Picea schrenkiana forest in the west of Tianshan Mountains had been taken as the research object. The method of drawing a box map had been used to quantitatively explore the impact of terrain, climate and soil on the biomass. The method of integrating ordinary kriging and machine learning had been used to predict the spatial distribution of Picea schrenkiana biomass. The results had shown that there is a close relationship between the changes of environmental variables, which jointly determines the spatial distribution of the biomass of Picea tianshanica. Picea tianshanica prefers to be located in the middle mountain shady slope area with an altitude of 1500-2700m, and the graybrown forest soil has good water conservation capacity and high nutrients. Moreover, there is a spatial clustering of the biomass of Picea. The high-value clustering of the biomass is concentrated in Tex, Gongliu and Xinyuan areas. The low value clusters of biomasses are concentrated on the south slope of the southern Tianshan Mountains, while the high/low value clusters of biomasses in the northern Tianshan Mountains are staggered and concentrated on a small scale.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Harmonic Response Analysis for Small Out-Line Package
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In order to discuss the influence of the number of sheets on acceleration and frequency curve of sample surface, the finite element model of clamp, SOP sample and metal sheet is firstly established with Solidworks. Different number of sheets are laid on the surface of SOP sample. Then changing the number of the paper sheets, harmonic response analysis is converted based on modal analysis. The influence of different number of sheet on acceleration and frequency curve is discussed. The results show the relation between acceleration-frequency curve of different thickness of paper, which provides reference for packaging design.

articleTitle: Design of Dual Code Traceability System for Agricultural Products Based on RSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s economy, QR code has achieved good development as a new technology, and many merchants have begun to use QR code technology to sell, adulterate, and fabricate agricultural products. The agricultural product traceability and anti-counterfeiting system is based on internet technology and utilizes relevant computer programming software to establish traceability archives, including the traceability code, product name, affiliated distributor, and detailed introduction of the agricultural product, for the convenience of consumers’ inquiry and supervision. In terms of anti-counterfeiting technology, due to its ease of imitation and forgery, manufacturers need to invest heavily in the development of this technology, and there are drawbacks such as difficulty in detection and lack of uniqueness. In response to the above issues, this article proposes a dual code traceability system for agricultural products based on RSA algorithm. The experimental results indicate that the system not only achieves systematic management and monitoring of the production, processing, and transportation of fruit and vegetable agricultural products, but also achieves product traceability and anti-counterfeiting by encrypting product information QR codes.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Network Multi node Communication System Integrating Artificial Intelligence Technology and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the development of network communication, there have been shortwave communication systems, microwave communication systems, and mobile communication systems. Different network communication systems have different advantages and disadvantages, which makes modern network communication diverse. However, most of the current design methods for embedded multi node network communication systems cannot achieve efficient control of energy consumption, which requires further innovation in network communication system design. In this regard, this article integrates AI (Artificial Intelligence) technology and GA (Genetic Algorithm) to optimize the network multi node communication system. The research results indicate that traditional methods have high energy loss, while the energy loss of the network multi node communication optimization system based on AI fusion GA designed in this article is significantly lower than traditional methods, and the optimization effect of network multi node communication is better than traditional methods. This is because in order to improve network communication speed, the method in this article utilizes scientific and reasonable methods to optimize network communication, introducing AI fusion GA into its system, reducing system latency and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Children’s Dance Somatosensory Interaction System Based on Action Evaluation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Its core is that it allows computers to have more accurate and effective “eyes” to observe the world and complete various dance instructions according to human movements. The movements of the human body have various forms of expression, including body postures or movement processes such as arms, head, face, and limbs. At present, children’s dance teachers are basically dance graduates. Although they have strong professional dance skills, they lack the understanding of children’s physiology and psychology, and are accustomed to directly imposing the content and methods of adult dance training on children. In terms of thinking, it is also of great benefit to the development of children’s thoughts. However, in children’s dance teaching, not all movements are suitable for children. The key to how to choose dance movements suitable for children lies in the grasp of dance teachers. The somatosensory interaction method is most similar to the natural movement of the human itself, which can more intuitively reflect the human movement to the virtual world of the computer. It has a more realistic experience and reduces the difficulty of the user’s operation, making the digital technology public more widely. The fundamental purpose of children’s dance should be to let children pursue and enjoy the pleasure that dance can bring to individuals, rather than let children master rigid and standardized dance movements through cruel, single and boring repetitive training. The dance somatosensory interaction system based on somatosensory interaction is a new way to think about how to use somatosensory technology and equipment for human-computer interaction. Including the design of somatosensory interaction interface, user operation experience, dance action design, human-computer interaction mode, etc. Instead of simply using somatosensory interactive device technology to replace the click operation of mouse and keyboard. This paper mainly aims at giving full play to the role of digital somatosensory interactive experience. Children can fully mobilize their subjective initiative in the process of participation, which provides a new way and great convenience for children’s dance.

articleTitle: Mass Data Quality Improvement System for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper relates to a mass data quality improvement system for distribution network, which includes: physical system, repair system, data quality evaluation system, data service system, business application system, data visualization system, control layer system. This paper supports offline analysis and online analysis of massive data repair under different scenarios, multi-dimensional and multi-level data quality evaluation system, which can effectively improve the quality and credibility of distribution network data, solve common key technical problems in the field of distribution data, and realize dynamic management and data repair of data with different life cycles; Provide data interfaces for various business systems that meet business application requirements, and realize the integration and expansion of typical application modules such as distribution network load forecasting technology, reactive power optimization, energy conservation and loss reduction.

articleTitle: Optimal Layout Algorithm Design in Large-scale Civil Engineering Projects Based on Intelligent Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper aims to design an optimal layout algorithm for large-scale civil engineering projects based on intelligent sensor networks, so as to improve the construction quality and efficiency of the projects. This paper adopts the method of combining theoretical analysis with empirical research to conduct in-depth research. Firstly, the related theories of intelligent sensor network and optimal layout algorithm are deeply studied, and its application prospect in large-scale civil engineering projects is analyzed. Secondly, an optimal layout algorithm of large-scale civil engineering projects based on intelligent sensor network is designed and implemented, and it is verified by experimental simulation. Finally, the research results are summarized comprehensively, and the future research direction and prospect are discussed. The experimental simulation results show that the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm are at an ideal level. Compared with the random layout algorithm, the optimized layout algorithm proposed in this paper is more efficient, and its accuracy can be about 18% higher. Through the research of this paper, we hope to provide a more optimized and accurate layout algorithm for large-scale civil engineering projects, so as to improve the construction quality and efficiency of the projects.

articleTitle: Research on Post-Processing of Interior Decoration Renderings Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the progress of computer image processing technology, two-dimensional and three-dimensional technology based on image processing has also played a great role in interior decoration. Especially in terms of interior decoration design, image processing software such as Photoshop and 3D MAX will be widely used in the current market as the design and processing of interior renderings. Indoor renderings are widely used in the field of home decoration and public decoration. Different users have different needs for the renderings generated. This paper focuses on how to use computer image processing technology to process the later effect drawing of interior decoration, which can avoid the complex process of designers’ design effect drawing in the past, effectively reduce the cost of making design effect drawing and produce the effect drawing required by users. Genetic algorithm is used to optimize the color matching of interior decoration materials. This algorithm improves the design efficiency and the working accuracy of the equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Active Network Security Structure Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Active network security is a comprehensive strategy, which aims to reduce the impact of network threats on organizations by taking multi-level measures. This requires continuous efforts and investment to ensure that the network and information systems can remain secure. The traditional network security protection of security guards, antivirus software and firewalls is often single, so it is difficult to actively defend against network threats. In this paper, active defense is applied to complex networks, and a new active network security structure model is established. According to the characteristics of nonlinear time series of NSS (Network security situation) values, the model uses the advantages of SVM (support vector machine) to fit nonlinear data, and uses PSO (Particle swarm optimization) to optimize the parameters of SVM, and proposes an NSS prediction method based on PSO-SVM. The simulation results show that compared with other NSS evaluation models, PSO-SVM has the least modeling time and evaluation time, and the smallest error of the prediction model, which verifies the superiority of its prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Cultural Resources Information System of Road Book Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the development and innovation of new technologies such as Internet of things, big data and cloud computing, the learning environment of major universities is particularly important. Through the combination of design and Internet of things technology, realize the development trend of intelligence, technology and science and technology, so as to improve the management of classroom informatization level and the full use of educational resources in Colleges and universities. The road book culture based on Internet of things technology provides readers with convenient equipment and efficient services. Building a new intelligent library in line with China’s local reality and readers’ needs can help the library carry out double-layer innovation in service and business. This paper expounds the concept of the Internet of things and the connotation of the road book culture, and analyzes the construction content of the road book culture from the aspects of e-book card, self-service borrowing and returning system, intelligent bookshelf, intelligent printer, environmental detection system, automatic security system and so on. The construction path of road book culture based on the Internet of things needs to be integrated in two aspects: business processing system and library management system, and improve the existing services of the library in three aspects: personalized service, intelligent service and resource sharing service.

articleTitle: Eye Tracking Technology in the Field of Intelligent Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Eye tracking is a kind of applied technology which is used to record and measure eye movement, and it can record the orientation the eye look. In addition it have a lot of way to take down the data and some of the model of the eye-tracking. So if we can connect the technology with the intelligent cars, eye tracking will be a powerful tool in connecting drivers and the different way we drive a car would be found and it can make people don’t too concentrate on driving cars. Since cause of the difference of light of each places and the individual difference of the eyes, it is still a challenging in this field. Also, the using of the artificial intelligence (AI) in the automatic cars is becoming a hopeful research direction and the eye tracking can provide data of it which can help AL to identify thing it should be yield. When these two things connected, the automatic driving will be more accurate and mature. The paper is talking about the the application and development of the intelligent driving with eye tracking in the nearly five years and discussing about the future suggestions of the bond of eye tracking and the AI.

articleTitle: Design of Energy Efficiency Management System for Mechanical and Electrical Equipment Based on Genetic Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the acceleration of industrialization and the increasing shortage of energy resources, the energy efficiency management of electromechanical equipment is particularly crucial. This article proposes a management system design method based on GA (Genetic Algorithm) for optimizing the energy efficiency of electromechanical equipment. GA, inspired by natural selection and genetic mechanisms, has been widely applied in various optimization problems. This study first reviewed the basic principles of GA, including its encoding strategy, selection mechanism, cross operation, and mutation operation, among other key technologies. Through experimental verification, the results show that compared with traditional energy efficiency management methods, the method proposed in this paper shows significant advantages in convergence speed, solution quality, and system stability. In summary, this article provides a new and efficient optimization strategy for the field of energy efficiency management of electromechanical equipment, and its practicality and superiority have been verified through experiments. It is expected that this method can be further promoted and applied, contributing to the improvement of industrial energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Embedded Computer Room Air Conditioning Remote Control System Based on PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: How to monitor and manage the air conditioning system effectively and reasonably to make it reach the best working state has become a hot issue in current research. In order to improve the performance and efficiency of the control system and reduce the energy waste and maintenance cost, this article uses artificial neural network (ANN) to adjust and optimize the parameters of PID regulator online, and then uses the adjusted PID regulator to control the system in real time. The results show that the PID algorithm based on ANN has good performance in control error, control accuracy and stability, and can adjust parameters adaptively, with strong robustness and adaptability. The application of PID algorithm based on ANN in remote control system of air conditioning in computer room is feasible, which can effectively improve the control accuracy and stability of the system and has a wide application prospect. Future research directions include further optimizing the performance of the algorithm, improving its adaptability and robustness, and studying how to apply other intelligent control algorithms to the remote control system of air conditioning in the computer room.

articleTitle: Visualization Technology of Building Structure Simulation Analysis Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The development of China’ s construction industry shows an increasing trend. During the “Thirteenth Five-Year Plan” period, the added value of the construction industry increased by 18.9% annually, and the rapid development of the construction industry highlighted the important role of project management in construction projects. In recent years, with the development of signal processing theory and computer hardware and software technology, computer vision has made great progress in both theory and practice, and a large number of practical systems have been applied in various fields of production and life, such as the construction industry. Many of these systems apply computer vision to the measurement of spatial geometric position and size of objects, resulting in computer vision measurement system. This paper discusses the adaptability of computer vision technology as a basic supervision technology to the basic research problems in this paper, and puts forward a method of identifying supervision objects of construction projects based on the characteristics of engineering apparent visual process. This new method is a research hotspot of construction engineering management, and it also plays an important role in the development of computer vision in China.

articleTitle: Research on Ordering and Transshipment Scheme Based on Linear Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Procurement is a common problem in the field of economy and finance. In practice, an enterprise’s procurement strategy will directly affect its production activities, and even affect its subsequent income and development. Therefore, enterprises should formulate reasonable ordering plans and transportation plans in advance to meet future production activities, which are closely related to suppliers and forwarders. In order to make the results more reasonable, accurate and reliable, we set the evaluation index, use the entropy weight method to determine the corresponding weight, and use TOPSIS model to establish the evaluation system. After ranking the suppliers with this evaluation model, the suppliers with unqualified order rate will be eliminated, and the final scores will be sorted in ascending order, that is, the lower the score, the better, and the most important 50 suppliers will be obtained. How many suppliers can the enterprise choose to supply at least to meet the production demand, and formulate the most economical weekly ordering scheme and the least loss transshipment scheme 24 weeks in advance. Using the 0-1 programming in linear programming, using meeting the weekly demand and the actual situation as constraints, and taking the minimum number of suppliers as the objective function to establish the minimum number of suppliers model, the final minimum number of suppliers is 47. The actual situation is used as the constraint condition, and the “most economical” is used as the objective function to solve the optimal ordering scheme. Similarly, the transportation scheme with less loss is solved by satisfying the production and selecting only one forwarder as the constraint condition, and taking “least loss” as the objective function.

articleTitle: Design of English Speaking Exam System Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The English oral exam is an important component of language learning, but the traditional exam mode uses face-to-face exams between teachers and students. This oral exam mode has strong subjectivity for examiners, and their oral proficiency, pronunciation, and other factors directly affect the performance of candidates. Although there are videos of the entire exam sent to the exam center, the exam center can only conduct sampling inspections at most, resulting in unfair grading. In this regard, this article designs an English speaking exam system based on PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization), which can achieve online registration and login authentication for candidates. Online exams use computers to extract test questions from the established question bank according to the paper formation algorithm, and form test papers that meet the requirements. It is an effective means to achieve standardized and scientific examination. Implement online testing of different types of English knowledge, allowing users to analyze and count their test scores. And through experimental testing, the experimental results show that PSO has reached a convergence value of 682 when the number of iterations is 1150, while the GA (Genetic Algorithm) algorithm needs 2100 iterations to reach the optimal value. It can be seen that the algorithm proposed in this article is more suitable for English oral testing.

articleTitle: Low Power Application Design of Adaptive Circuits Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The theme of low-power design involves different levels of system algorithm level, logic, circuit, layout, as well as devices and processes in integrated circuit design. How to design a low power consumption, low latency, small area resource consumption, and high accuracy system is crucial for solving the current problem. In recent years, DL (Deep Learning) has been proven to have absolute suriority in achieving the accuracy of different sech recognition tasks. In this regard, this article attempts to design the application of DL algorithm in low-power adaptive circuits. The research results show that the average detection rate in the training set is 96.5%, and the average false detection rate is 4.7%; The average detection rate of the validation set is 91.3%, and the average false detection rate is 7%. It can be seen that the algorithm in this article has completed the circuit design for low-power CNN (Convolutional Neural Network). It can be seen that the adaptive bias circuit in this article does not require additional static current, but instead uses a very small bias current to comnsate for the transistor threshold voltage. This not only reduces the power consumption of the orational amplifier circuit, but also further reduces the power consumption of the entire circuit, meeting the design requirements of low-power circuits.

articleTitle: Research on Welding Parameter Optimization and Automatic Control Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of welding technology requirements in the manufacturing industry, automation and parameter optimization of the welding process have become increasingly important. This article studies the optimization and automation control method of welding parameters based on ML (Machine Learning) algorithm, aiming to achieve high-quality, efficient, and highly automated welding processes. By analyzing and processing a large amount of welding data, we have developed a series of prediction models for real-time prediction and adjustment of welding parameters, such as current, voltage, and welding speed, to ensure welding quality. In addition, we have proposed an ML based automation control strategy that can automatically adjust and control the welding process in actual production. We used various ML algorithms, including regression analysis, neural networks, and support vector machines, to establish predictive models for welding parameters. In addition, we also studied the automation control methods of the welding process and proposed an ML based automation control strategy. This strategy uses a prediction model as input, automatically adjusting welding parameters and equipment settings based on real-time welding status and prediction results to achieve the best welding effect.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Porosity of Textile Materials Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As a necessity of people’s life, textile materials mainly play the basic function of covering and keeping warm. With the improvement of people’s living standards, higher requirements are put forward for textile materials and their production technology, which must meet the human body’s thermal and wet comfort, contact comfort and clothing beauty and comfort. The design of functional textile materials is mainly to determine the physical and geometric parameters of textile materials according to the requirements of textile comfort, warmth preservation and other functions, so as to optimize the performance of textile materials and provide theoretical basis and scientific reference for garment design manufacturers. In traditional production technology, the main method of textile material design is based on life experience or scientific experiment. The method used in this paper is particle swarm optimization algorithm. The basic principle of its algorithm is very simple, and it uses few parameters. It converges quickly in the early stage of evolution and is relatively easy to be realized. Many scholars paid great attention to it when it was first proposed. It has developed rapidly and has developed greatly in a short time.

articleTitle: An Optimization Model Design of Distributed Cloud Computing Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: How to use existing resources to allocate and schedule cloud tasks reasonably and improve the utilization rate of cloud computing resources has become a bottleneck in the development of cloud computing platform. In this paper, an optimization model of distributed cloud computing based on improved GA (Genetic Algorithm) is proposed. The coding mode code based on the combination of binary coding and floating-point coding is adopted, and any scheduling scheme has a corresponding coding scheme, which can ensure the completeness of the search space. At the same time, layered technology is added to individual decoding and initialization population. Simulation results show that the scheduling time of this algorithm is shorter, and the advantages of this algorithm will be more obvious with the increase of the number of cloud tasks. In this paper, the standard deviation of task running time on each computing resource is used to optimize the load balance, and the effect is good. The improved GA in this paper is effective, which can effectively reduce the probability of the algorithm falling into local optimum, and the algorithm is less likely to fall into local optimum in the initial stage and converges faster. Experimental results show that this algorithm is superior to adaptive GA, and it is an effective TS (Task scheduling) algorithm in distributed cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Management of Nursing Quality Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of human society and computer information technology, the accumulation of massive data makes people have to improve data mining technology to reveal hidden, potentially valuable and unknown information. Data mining not only integrates technologies such as database, artificial intelligence and machine learning, but also is widely used in finance, commerce, medical treatment, insurance and other industries. The decision tree model of whether the nursing quality is excellent and the decision tree model of whether the nursing quality is qualified were established. The decision tree classification method is undoubtedly one of the most commonly used and classic methods in many data mining methods. The decision tree analysis method provides a nursing workload platform at the same level for nursing quality assessment, reduces the impact of nursing workload differences on nursing quality evaluation, and improves the comparability of nursing quality among nursing workload units at the same level. The decision tree model of nursing quality management evaluation was established to make nursing quality management more scientific. In this paper, the decision tree model of nursing quality management evaluation is established by using decision tree technology, which is concrete and intuitive and has high classification accuracy. It provides a new research idea and analysis method for nursing quality management.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis and Quality Control of Assisted Reproductive Technology Based on Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Reproductive medicine has made continuous progress with the development of modern medicine. In China, the development of assisted reproductive technology is not mature, and there is a lack of a systematic and scientific nursing management model. Assisted reproductive technology is an important means of diagnosis and treatment of infertility. With the development of science, a series of new technologies in this field have developed rapidly and new technologies have been born. Assisted reproductive technology based on in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer has opened up an assisted reproductive pathway for infertile women, but the clinical pregnancy rate has been low. The establishment, design and laboratory quality control system of in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer laboratory is an important part of assisted reproductive technology. The purpose of laboratory quality control is to formulate a series of measures to maintain the stability of IVF process and ensure the stability of used instruments, equipment, culture medium and materials, which is the basis of quality assurance. The factors affecting the success of clinical pregnancy are not only the superovulation scheme and egg quality, but also the laboratory culture system. Combined with clinical nursing experience, this paper discusses the nursing management of assisted reproductive technology.

articleTitle: Internet-Based Civil Engineering Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper studies a civil engineering monitoring system based on wireless communication. The data acquisition module is connected with the data processing module and the power supply module; The data processing module is connected with the data acquisition module and the power supply module; The first wireless data communication transceiver module is connected with the data processing module and the power supply module, and the wireless data transceiver is transmitted; Power module provides power; The second wireless data communication transceiver module is connected with the central processing unit for wireless data transmission; The central processing unit is connected with the second wireless data communication transceiver module and data server for data calculation; The data server is connected with the central processing unit, and the database data is stored and analyzed; Wireless communication is used for wireless data transmission between the first wireless data communication transceiver module and the second wireless data communication transceiver module. This paper reduces the monitoring cost of civil engineering, increases the intelligent degree of civil engineering monitoring system, improves the monitoring accuracy and improves the practicability.

articleTitle: Optimization on Installing Bracket for Fast Handling Trailer of Aircrafts
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The installing bracket is the main load-bearing component of fast handling trailer. Its design plays a key role in the overall quality of fast handling trailer. In order to design the strength and rigidity to meet the requirements of light installing bracket, the paper uses the CATIA software of Dassault to establish the three-dimensional finite element modle of the installing bracket, analyzes it with the finite element analysis (FEA) based on the full load condition, obtains the distribution of stress and displacement. Accroding to the analysis results, the size of the maximum stess concentration part of the installing bracket is optimized, and its optimal design scheme is obtained on the premise of ensuring the strength and rigidity of the installing bracket. The results provide the theoretical basis for its optimal design.

articleTitle: Equipment Reliability Analysis Based on Grey Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The reliability of equipment is an important index in the whole life cycle management of equipment. How to evaluate its scientific preparation has always been a key issue in related research fields. With the development of various data mining technologies, cluster analysis has gradually been applied to equipment reliability analysis. In view of the complexity of existing equipment, this paper selects grey clustering method to study its application in equipment reliability analysis, and explores effective ways to solve problems in equipment reliability analysis while taking advantage of the characteristics of this method.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Reality Interventions in Medicine
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) has been increasingly applied in mental and psychotic disorder treatment, physical pain therapy, and training and learning. This article conducted a literature review on studies that comprehended the application of VR interventions in the three areas and listed a few examples of how VR is implemented in each of these areas. Then, the article discussed the advantages and limits of VR compared to traditional interventions. Specifically, this paper analyzes the current research status of VR in the treatment of mental and mental disorders, the treatment of physical pain, and training and learning. In the treatment of mental and mental disorders, differences between physical pain treatment and traditional interventions are discussed. The advantages of VR therapy compared with traditional methods are summarized, while the limitations of VR therapy are also discussed. The advantages of VR therapy are summarized in terms of training and learning, and the application cases in the medical field are analyzed. In the end, the paper summarizes the whole paper, and the related research content has certain reference value for the future development of this field.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Objective Optimal Control Algorithm for Flexible Load of Urban Electric Warehouse Based on Model Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: FL (flexible load) refers to the load that can change the power consumption time or load size to match the DR strategy of power operators, so as to obtain economic benefits. Load management improves the load curve by actively adjusting the user load, which is an important method of demand side response. Based on the model-based prediction, this paper designs the multi-objective optimal control algorithm of urban electric warehouse FL. The system optimization model consists of the objective function, decision variables and constraints that need to be solved in this paper. GA (Genetic Algorithm) is adopted as the solution algorithm, and the FL control model of urban electricity warehouse is solved and calculated by establishing a joint optimization program of Matlab and Simulink. There is a certain discrepancy between the predicted power and the actual power, and the average absolute percentage error of the power is 8.12 %, which meets the requirements. Through the scheduling of time-of-use electricity price and FL, the fluctuation of new energy is effectively absorbed and matched in most time periods, thus verifying the effectiveness and feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment Model of Urban Rail Transit Based on State Space Model Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, many large and medium-sized cities in China are accelerating the construction of urban rail transit. The contradiction between urban transportation capacity and traffic volume has become increasingly prominent, and urban rail transit has shown its advantages, gradually becoming the first choice for countries to alleviate traffic pressure. Urban rail transit has entered the era of network operation, its scale is constantly expanding, and the potential safety hazards accompanying the operation process are constantly increasing, making the operation safety management more difficult. On the one hand, the vigorous construction of urban rail transit and the annual increase of passenger flow all over the country, on the other hand, the frequent accidents of urban rail transit have caused serious casualties, property losses and adverse social impacts. Under the trend of developing all-round three-dimensional transportation network in our country, urban rail transit system has become an important means to solve urban congestion with its superior performance. By regulating the distribution of human resources and rationalizing the use of material resources, rail transit system can bring maximum economic benefits to operators and maximize benefits for society, which is a hot topic of social discussion and attention at present.

Author Keywords: State space model and evolutionary algorithm

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Load Balancing Optimization for Cloud Computing Data Stream Storage Based on Big Data Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Optimizing the storage load balancing of data streams in cloud computing can improve the uniformity of data stream storage distribution within the network. The traditional method’s processing power is only limited to the window range that a certain operator can handle at the node. When the data gradually increases, the processing power is insufficient, which can easily lead to data flow congestion. Moreover, it ignores the research on the load distribution of the entire system and migration strategies in dynamic load balancing. Optimizing load balancing of data streams requires evaluating the load situation of data stream storage nodes, transferring high-intensity loads to nodes with lighter loads, and completing the optimization of data stream storage load balancing. To address the shortcomings of existing load balancing methods, this paper proposes a simulation design method for optimizing load balancing of cloud computing data stream storage based on big data algorithms. This method analyzes the historical load data of storage nodes, uses big data algorithms to predict the future load situation of nodes, and dynamically allocates data to corresponding nodes based on this to achieve balanced distribution and optimization of load. The experimental results show that the proposed method has high feasibility, good computational performance, and dynamic load balancing.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Computer Maintenance Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the popularization of computers, people’s demand for computers has increased significantly, and computers will inevitably have many problems in the process of use. As the computer maintenance department of an enterprise, it needs to accurately and conveniently manage the computer maintenance business of customers, and timely and accurately provide the warehousing information of spare parts to the department staff. This system uses Python as the development language, Pyqt5 as the window design control, and MySQL database as the data information to provide effective operation management. A set of convenient, fast and user-friendly computer maintenance management information system is constructed. The system can save a lot of time for maintenance personnel and help them complete their work efficiently.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Dynamic Integrated Marketing Decision Model Based on Personalized Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Enterprise marketing decisions includes four aspects: product decision, product pricing decision, promotion decision and distribution channel decision. This topic only studies some modeling and optimization problems in product pricing decision and promotion decision, and two decision-making optimization problems in promotion combination decision. Consumer behavior has also undergone earth-shaking changes. Consumers are not limited to physical stores or the Internet, and they will make full use of all kinds of channel information to bring enough convenience and meet the needs of maximizing utility. Therefore, this paper will build a new marketing model with consumer demand as the core, including dynamic communication and value transfer through personalized recommendation algorithm, and on this basis, with the help of Internet big data, realize the transformation of marketing model through collaborative online and offline business, so as to gain competitive advantage and promote the continuous improvement of sales scale. To ensure the consistency of products and services provided by various channel types to consumers, enterprises should focus their investment on the most important key points in the decision-making process in order to target the right customers.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Distance Course Learning System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The author proposed a remote teaching system design based on computer big data technology. The system is connected to the communication machine through the Ethernet interface RS485, and the communication machine is built by the industrial control board, the driver chip and the on-board dip switch. According to the function module of the system using JSP technology design system page, according to the priority of teaching management business reasonable allocation of network bandwidth resources to achieve remote teaching management. System combined with the theory of multiple attribute decision making form the first remote education curriculum decision-making matrix to obtain operation unit organization form and the remote education branch of the organization form of knowledge. Set up an extraction model of quality and effective resources for distance education. The results show that the information-based distance teaching system proposed in this paper can effectively improve the teaching quality of distance education courses and has strong scalability.

articleTitle: Simulation of Industrial Internet Reliability Assessment Model Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the Industrial Internet of Things (IIOT), communication and data exchange between devices are normal. These communications and data exchanges often involve sensitive information and important data, such as production data and equipment status. If these data are leaked or tampered with, it may cause serious security consequences and economic losses. Therefore, the security of IIOT must be fully guaranteed. This article studies the application of ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm and machine learning (ML) in IIOT security management.
