By comparing and verifying the performance of ant colony optimization neural network (ACO-NN), back propagation neural network (BPNN) and traditional risk assessment methods in data filtering and processing, prediction accuracy and real-time, the superiority of ACO-NN algorithm is verified. The experimental results show that ACO-NN algorithm can effectively filter out noise and outliers in data preprocessing, and has excellent global search ability, avoiding the problem of local optimal solution. In addition, ACO-NN combined with neural network (NN) has strong forecasting ability, and the risk forecasting accuracy is over 96 %, and the real-time performance is also excellent, and the processing time is short. Therefore, ACO-NN algorithm is an accurate and efficient method in the reliability assessment of IIOT, and it has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Sensor Measurement and Control System Based on Genetic Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This article designs an embedded sensor measurement and control system based on Genetic PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization), which combines the advantages of simple design, fast convergence speed, and easy expression of GA (Genetic Algorithm) in solving combinatorial optimization problems. Possible solutions that can better solve such engineering optimization problems and determine the optimal solution. The software and hardware partitioning problem is fundamentally an optimization problem, and multi entity search algorithms such as genetic PSO can be referenced to find the optimal solution to the problem. The research results indicate that in terms of partitioning results, our algorithm outperforms ACA (Ant Colony Algorithm) and DL (Deep Learning). Compared to ACA, when the number of nodes is 30, the total time of our algorithm is relatively flat, with an average time of 0.33 seconds. When the number of nodes is 49, the average time of the algorithm in this paper is still at the lowest among the three algorithms, at 0.36s. PSO can be used to solve software and hardware partitioning problems, and is not considered during the software and hardware partitioning process; The number of instruction codes required for each software node implementation or the memory resources required for processor scheduling vary.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Road Surface Recognition Based on Dynamic Slip Rate Bounds
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Due to the fixed slip ratio threshold being difficult to balance accuracy and response speed in estimating tire-road friction coefficient, this paper proposes a method that combines a seven degree-of-freedom vehicle dynamics model, a tire kinematics model, and a Kalman filter to estimate lateral and longitudinal forces on the vehicle’s tires. Then, the brush tire model and recursive least squares estimation method are employed to identify the tire-road friction coefficient during overtaking maneuvers. Finally, a dynamic slip ratio boundary is designed to optimize the road recognition algorithm. Simulation analysis shows that this proposed algorithm can accurately identify the tire-road friction coefficient and respond to its changes in a timely manner.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Detection and Simulation of Power Distribution Network Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The power distribution network directly targets a large number of electricity users, and its operating environment is very complex. Various complex faults often occur during the operation process. How to reduce the number of faults during the operation of the distribution network and improve the reliability of the power supply system has become a difficult problem that the power system needs to focus on solving. In this regard, this article uses fuzzy clustering algorithm to detect faults in power distribution networks, and simulation experiments show that the number of ACA(Ant Colony Algorithm) misclassified samples is relatively large, which is far from the actual situation. However, the number of misclassified samples in this algorithm is 7. Compared to the number of misclassified samples in ACA, the value of our algorithm is at the optimal value. In the experiment of misdiagnosis rate, it can also be found that the misdiagnosis rate of our algorithm is also relatively low, only 4.9%. The objective function value is 0.52, which is also better than ACA 0.8. Through experimental results, it can be seen that the algorithm in this paper can accurately distinguish circuit faults. The line selection technology for single-phase grounding faults in distribution networks has become a focus of attention for power workers. It is necessary to carefully analyze the problem, accurately identify the faulty line, and ensure the safe, normal, and effective operation of the entire distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Order Policy Based on Multi-Stage Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In order to study the problem of selecting suppliers and ordering different categories of raw materials, a decision-making method combined with evaluation models and dynamic planning is proposed based on relevant data from suppliers and forwarders between 2016 and 2020. Firstly, an evaluation model applying gray correlation analysis and entropy weight method is developed to narrow down the range of suppliers waiting to be selected, and then a multi-stage dynamic planning model is established to make a decision on the order policy. After that, it is analyzed empirically. And the final results demonstrates that the selected suppliers supply raw materials stably, the order policy is feasible for long-term implementation and the total cost of it is low.

articleTitle: Holographic Projection Technology Based on Multiple Drones
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Holographic projection technology can meet the needs of people’s scientific research, education, business and other needs, is a crucial step in the development of the information age. This paper imaginatively proposes a multiUAV-based holographic projection technology and develops a multi-UAV swarm unit, which addresses the shortcomings of the holographic projection technology that cannot move in all directions and cannot be moved, in order to overcome the limitations of the current holographic projection technology and fully utilize the booming UAV technology.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Forecast Simulation Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Regional economic potential is affected by too many entities and large dynamic changes in economic structure. The proportion of changes is strongly non-linear. There are information redundancy and information interference between different impact indicators, leading to the prediction results obtained by traditional economic potential development prediction methods. Affected by this sudden change, there is a problem of local optimality, which causes large errors. The efficient development of regional economy is of great significance to the progress of my country’s overall economy. And scientific forecasting and planning of regional economic aggregates can ensure the scientific nature of regional economic development. The problem of accurate forecasting of agricultural economy. The agricultural economy has a chaotic and nonlinear complex system. Traditional methods ignore the chaotic nature of agricultural economic changes, and it is difficult to accurately describe its changing laws, resulting in low prediction accuracy. According to the nature of economic ecological construction based on green production, the basic idea of agricultural economic ecological construction and the general model of system dynamics for its simulation process are proposed based on the decision tree algorithm for the construction of economic order based on green production and the dynamic characteristics of agricultural economic ecological system.

articleTitle: Simulation of Public Opinion Propagation Model of News APP Network Based on Improved Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Web opinion expresses the will of the public to a certain extent. Although it has the commonness of public opinion in the general society, it has the basic characteristics of a complex system in the virtual society because of the influence scope and communication speed of the Internet, so its communication tendency and development direction are paid attention to. Mobile Internet has become an irreversible trend, which is profoundly changing people’s living habits and even their way of life. In this article, a public opinion propagation model of news APP network based on improved collaborative filtering (CF) algorithm is proposed. The results show that the model constructed in this article can not only describe the change of the proportion of communication subjects in the network, but also simulate the communication vitality and scope of news APP mobile web opinion. Web opinion presents more complicated and difficult-to-describe communication and evolution characteristics than traditional public opinion, which makes traditional research methods and means unsustainable. The model constructed in this article has certain reference value for public opinion analysis, judgment and pre-alarm of mobile networks.

articleTitle: Research on Prototype Tool Improvement System Based on Power Internet Reference Application Scenario Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The prototype system of power Internet application business risk management is the basis for the research of power Internet operation and maintenance, risk management and fault early warning. Integrate existing simulation data and various computing resources of power system to provide parallel/distributed high-performance computing. A service based grid application development platform is constructed to meet the needs of large-scale power system computing and operation and maintenance monitoring. A distributed resource storage and retrieval mechanism is designed and implemented, which is coordinated by multiple resource monitoring servers. The results show that the prototype system has the characteristics of processing distributed heterogeneous data, utilizing distributed computing power and storing computing results in a decentralized manner. The system meets the requirements of multi regional and multi-level power Internet application business risk management.

articleTitle: Design of English Education Resource Sharing Model Based on Improved Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The purpose of resource sharing is to improve resource utilization and reduce redundant construction of resources. It concentrates the resource information and its external related information in one center, and processes and distributes requests and resources in a unified way. In the English education resource sharing model studied in this paper, resource browsing is the most important function. How to ensure the quick and accurate display of resources that each user wants to browse, the classification of resources plays an important role. Through the development of cloud computing software based on Hadoop platform, the optimal sharing state of English education resources in different regions and different needs can be realized. It will be more convenient for learners to acquire knowledge. The file entity storage environment of the English education resource sharing model is Hadoop cluster, and users’ requests are distributed to appropriate storage servers according to the processing of proxy servers. The load factor is used to improve the heuristic function in traditional ACO (ant colony optimization), so that more heavily loaded virtual machines can perform fewer tasks. The experimental results show that the load rate of the improved ACO in the whole cloud computing center is basically between 0.416 and 0.528, and the load of the cloud computing center is always in a balanced state.

articleTitle: Improvement Strategies of Urban Green Development Satisfaction Based on Text Analysis and SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this paper, we used the SVM algorithm and text analysis to study the views, feelings, and satisfaction of Xiamen citizens on the green development of Xiamen. Through the SVM algorithm, we classify the participants in the questionnaire on green development satisfaction and divide them into three groups, and then summarize the features of the classified groups. We also used text analysis to carry out the public complaint text crawled from the consultation and complaint module of the Xiamen Ecological Environment Bureau, and then the word frequency statistics and semantic network analysis of the complaint text were established. According to these pieces of information, we formulate strategies to improve the satisfaction of urban green development.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Power Grid Infrastructure Investment Model Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The optimization of infrastructure investment model belongs to the category of project portfolio optimization model, which not only has the general characteristics of project portfolio optimization model, that is, it is necessary to consider the relationship and influence among the projects in the portfolio, and determine the optimal portfolio under the condition of capital constraints. At present, there is little research on the optimal portfolio model of power grid. In this paper, the optimization research of power grid infrastructure investment model based on improved GA (genetic algorithm) is carried out. The optimization of power grid infrastructure investment model and improved GA are proposed and used to solve the model. The improved niche GA divides the objective function into two types: peak height and unequal height. If the function is equal peak value, it can be used directly. The accuracy of the algorithm optimization process is improved. The experimental results show that under the same change range, the change of annual operating cost has the greatest impact on the net present value, followed by investment cost, life span and operating income. The relative prediction error before the improvement is too large, and the relative prediction error after the improvement is reduced. It shows that the combined prediction method of this algorithm can reduce the relative error and make its value more balanced.

articleTitle: An Integrated Power-Distance Model Based on Power Distribution and Fatigue Recovery
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper studies the energy distribution in bicycle race. Firstly, the power distance model suitable for all kinds of passengers is established by combining the power time model with the power speed model. Second, we need to describe power curves to reflect the cycling abilities of sprinters and timing experts. The four indexes of power curve are displayed by radar chart, and it is concluded that the output power of sprinters is better when 5S and above, but worse when 1min and above. Finally, a muscle fatigue - recovery model was mixed to reflect the influence and sensitivity of riders who did not follow a power allocation scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Carrier Communication Matching in Internet of Things Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In Internet of Things (IOT) carrier communication, communication parameters can be used as input and communication performance as output, and the relationship between them can be modeled by machine learning (ML) algorithm, so as to optimize communication parameters. In this paper, an optimal design method of IOT carrier communication matching based on support vector machine (SVM) algorithm is proposed. The purpose of this study is to discuss the performance of the routing algorithm of IOT communication based on SVM, so as to solve the problem of malicious nodes and high packet loss rate faced by traditional routing schemes. The results show that the proposed algorithm has better performance than the traditional routing scheme and K- nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm, and can keep a relatively low packet loss rate growth when the quantity of malicious nodes increases, thus improving the reliability and stability of IOT communication. Compared with the traditional routing scheme, the effectiveness of this algorithm has obvious advantages, and it can keep a relatively low packet loss rate growth when the quantity of malicious nodes increases. This provides a new idea and method for the research of IOT communication routing algorithm.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation-Based Artistic Cutting Technology and Long Shot Analysis of Digital Film and Television Clips
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the digital age, the application of high technology makes the art of film and television editing diversified, the technology of film shooting and production keeps improving, and the visual effect presented is more and more stunning, which provides possibility and technical support for more film and television shooting. Rich editing effect, long-shot synthesis technology and surreal picture wonders provide new ideas for editing aesthetics, and make montage technique and long-shot school be integrated and unified. The course of digital film and television editing art should study the spatialization and time art of movies, which is reflected in the continuation of single shot and the connection of shots. Montage is not only a creative thinking, but also a viewing thinking. Long shot usually refers to a single shot with a time value of more than 30 seconds in a movie work. Conventional film works are generally composed of hundreds or even thousands of shots, some of which may be a fraction of a second in time, while others may be tens of seconds, minutes or even longer. This is what we call long shots. We can also say that a long shot is a complete paragraph formed by continuous shooting of a scene or a scene for a long time, and it is a montage of a single shot.

articleTitle: Image Recognition and Processing Algorithm of Power Grid Facilities Map Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The traditional image processing method of power grid facilities map is based on iconography, which can alleviate the artificial pressure to a certain extent. However, due to the slow speed and low accuracy of the traditional iconography method, it is difficult to be applied in the field of fault inspection. In order to realize intelligent power inspection more quickly and accurately, an image recognition and processing algorithm of power grid facilities map based on deep learning is proposed to solve the problems of occlusion, inaccurate classification and insufficient feature extraction in the actually collected power grid facilities map images. The convolution operation module and residual module in YOLOv5 algorithm are improved, and the learning depth of the algorithm is deepened by increasing the number of convolution layers. At the same time, the SENet attention mechanism is added to the basic convolution module. The research results show that the accuracy of this model for power equipment identification has reached more than $99 \%$. And the recognition accuracy of fault defects can reach $\mathbf{9 2. 7 4 6} \%$. This model improves the detection accuracy and speed of power grid facilities map images, and also provides a novel and feasible scheme for intelligent detection of power grid facilities map images.

articleTitle: Car Quality Prediction Based on Multiple Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As technology advances, the role that cars play in our daily lives increases. Both car manufactures and customers are eager to know about the car quality to help them choose the car they like. In this paper, three models were used to train and find the relationship between the car attributes and labels to predict the car quality. The dataset was found in the UCI dataset at first. Next the attributes and label of the data were changed into string type to fulfill the requirement of training the machine learning model. Then the dataset was divided into the training set and testing set to fit the model. The machine learning algorithms used in the article includes the Decision Tree model, Random Forest model, Extra Tree model. These models are used to train and test the dataset respectively and the accuracy of each model can be obtained. Finally, the most suitable hyperparameters in each model were found by using the validation curve. Experimental results indicate that the Random Forest model’s precision can reach to 85.66% and it is the most accurate one among three models. Thus, The Random Forest model would help the customers and manufacturers to have the better car.

articleTitle: Mechanical Equipment Failure Judgment and Prediction Based on Decision Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: During the operation of mechanical equipment, there will be inevitable wear and aging and other problems, and along with the increase of loss, it will lead to various failures, affecting production quality and efficiency. In order to solve this problem, this paper obtains data from the network, synthesizes the six indicators that cause mechanical equipment failure into three more comprehensive indicators - “machine-room temperature difference”, “power” and “work”, and uses the entropy weight method to find the weight of these three indicators for mechanical equipment failure. Then, using the decision tree model, a system is established to judge whether the equipment is faulty. Then, based on the XGBoost algorithm, the failure type of the equipment is further determined, and then through quantitative analysis, it is concluded that torque has an important influence on the mechanical equipment failure. Through the research in this paper, equipment maintenance can be accurately carried out, the overall industrial environment operation can be improved, and the economic benefits can be effectively increased.

articleTitle: Design of an Embedded Marine Environment Data Collection and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Marine resources are very important to humanity, but humans have done relatively little in the development and protection of marine resources. The collection of marine environmental data mainly involves collecting marine environmental data such as temperature and humidity, water flow velocity and direction, wind speed and direction. These data can help us better understand the ocean, monitor the ocean, develop the ocean, and play a positive role in transportation fields such as maritime transportation support and channel optimization. In order to solve the problems of high monitoring value deviation and low detection image clarity in traditional marine monitoring systems, this paper constructs a marine environmental data collection and automated monitoring system. Integrated application in research on embedded computers, wireless sensor networks, communication technology, and spatial processing technology can achieve real-time monitoring of the marine environment, real-time data processing, and dynamic visualization display. The experimental results show that the system meets the design indicators and can effectively achieve the collection and real-time monitoring of marine environmental data. The system can accurately and effectively collect and publish marine environmental elements.

articleTitle: Optimization of Computer in the Projection Pursuit Model of Comprehensive Evaluation of Water Pollution
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this paper, the differential evolution algorithm (DE) was used to search for the optimal projection direction of projective pursuit (PP) model, and a DE-PP comprehensive water quality evaluation model was proposed. In this paper, based on a simple projection index, a multivariate data classification model is established with a new optimization approach, and it is applied to the classification of standard water quality with multiple indexes. The water quality evaluation results of two examples show that this model can map high-dimensional data to low-dimensional subspace through the optimal projection direction. The model is convenient for sample classification and comprehensive evaluation. The model proposed in this paper provides a new idea and method for the research of water quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Network Topology and Information Propagation Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this article, PSO (Particle swarm optimization algorithm) algorithm is effectively combined with network topology and information propagation model, and an analysis method of network topology and information propagation based on improved PSO algorithm is proposed, which provides new ideas and methods for network optimization design. By comparing the algorithm performance under different network topologies and information dissemination models, the effectiveness and superiority of PSO algorithm are verified by experiments. The simulation results show that the average fitness value of PSO algorithm is obviously better than that of genetic algorithm (GA) and simulated annealing algorithm in the late iteration, and its value is closer to 1. Moreover, PSO algorithm is also less than GA and simulated annealing algorithm in the quantity of iterations needed to find the optimal solution. This means that PSO algorithm is more efficient and converges faster in solving network optimization problems. This shows that the fast convergence and excellent optimization ability of PSO algorithm make it have a wide application prospect in the fields of network topology and information dissemination analysis. The research in this article provides valuable reference for the research in this field.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristic Database System Based on NOSQL
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the demand of characteristic database construction, and expounds the construction of characteristic database system with NOSQL, so as to meet the application demand of characteristic database in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Construction of Students’ Information Management System in Higher Vocational Schools Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the improvement of the quantity and quality of personnel training and output, the number of students in higher vocational schools has gradually increased, so effective management of students in all aspects has become a practical problem that higher vocational schools need to consider. The traditional means of student information management is no longer suitable for the needs of higher vocational schools and students’ development. Traditional management methods are not only prone to errors, but also inefficient. At the same time, they also have problems such as untimely data update and nonstandard information management. In order to conform to the development trend of informatization in higher vocational schools, this article constructs a student information management system (IMS) in higher vocational schools based on deep learning (DL), and tests the functions of the system to further optimize the student IMS. The final test shows that the efficiency of the student IMS based on DL in higher vocational schools can reach $95.64 \%$. The data integration efficiency of this system is at a high level and has high stability, reaching around $97 \%$. It has certain superior performance and is easy to operate. It can provide certain technical support for student information management in vocational schools and achieve information management informatization in vocational schools.

articleTitle: Real-time Monitoring and Evaluation Algorithm of Civil Engineering Material Performance Based on Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Real-time monitoring of the performance of civil engineering materials is an important part to ensure the quality and safety of the project. Sensor technology uses various sensors to monitor the properties of materials, such as temperature, humidity, stress, strain and pressure. These sensors can collect data in real time and transmit the data to the monitoring system for engineers to make analysis and decision. In this paper, the real-time monitoring and evaluation algorithm of civil engineering materials based on sensors is studied. Multiple FGS (Fiber Grating Sensor) are laid on the upper and lower surfaces of reinforced concrete structures to form a distributed measuring system to measure the strain changes of reinforced concrete structures during loading. In order to effectively evaluate the seismic resistance of frame structures, an anisotropic damage model of concrete under constant lateral pressure is established based on the actual size and reinforcement of members in China’s current seismic design code. The research results show that the measurement data of FGS has enough accuracy and good reliability. This method can not only quantitatively evaluate the seismic capacity of buildings, but also find the parts with insufficient seismic capacity, which provides a foundation for subsequent reinforcement.

articleTitle: Effect Evaluation of Image Enhancement Algorithm for Power Grid Geographic Information System Based on Grey Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Power grid GIS (Geographic Information System) is an important part of power informatization. It organically combines all kinds of information in power grid with graphic information reflecting geographical position, realizes a spatial database system with topological structure and analysis function, and provides a powerful means to deal with graphic and non-graphic information. As one of the most important data analysis methods in the information age, cluster analysis is widely used in data mining and knowledge discovery, pattern recognition and classification, data compression and vector quantization. In this paper, an image enhancement algorithm of power grid GIS based on grey clustering is proposed. The algorithm divides the images into blocks, and performs histogram equalization according to the information content of each image. The research results show that this method has the best image quality, and the PSNR of the image output by this method is the highest, and the entropy of the algorithm is larger and the cross entropy is smaller. The simulation results show that the proposed improved algorithm can effectively improve the clarity of the image, make the image smoother, and improve the image enhancement effect.

articleTitle: Green Building Monitoring Method Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper studies a new green building data monitoring technology, which uses servers and readable storage media to monitor and manage buildings. Collect and monitor the first data collection behavior node of the building area through the data collection node and issue the policy adjustment instruction to the data collection node so that the data collection node can adjust the data collection behavior node according to the policy adjustment instruction. Collect and monitor the second data collection behavior node of the building area through the data collection node regularly, After obtaining the complete data collection information of the data collection node based on the policy adjustment instruction through the data collection node, the third data collection behavior node of the monitoring building area is collected through the data collection node, and each segmentation and collection section of the complete data collection information is monitored and processed according to the first data collection behavior node, the second data collection behavior node and the third data collection behavior node. In this way, the data acquisition process in the green building area can be continuously and accurately monitored through segmented monitoring.

articleTitle: Data Scheduling Algorithm of Mobile Education Streaming Media Based on Improved Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, the traditional media market has been integrated with the computer network, resulting in many new applications such as online video on demand, distance education, network television and so on. Streaming media is a technology that can play audio, video and other multimedia files on the Internet in real time without downloading and waiting. This paper builds a streaming media data scheduling model based on the improved random forest algorithm. First, it analyzes some indicators that affect the data flow, and then analyzes the accuracy of the improved random algorithm and its traditional algorithm under different decision tree numbers according to the improved forest algorithm. The gmean value of an improved random forest algorithm proposed in this paper is significantly higher than that of the traditional algorithm, and the fvalue is close to 0.92. It shows that the prediction accuracy of default and non-default samples is improved by this algorithm. It can improve the economic benefit and promote the establishment of an economical, smooth and efficient streaming media communication transmission system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Characteristics of Low Noise and Ultra Low Distortion IV Conversion Technology Based on Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As an important part of front-end signal processing, current-voltage (IV) conversion technology directly affects the performance and reliability of the whole system. The purpose of this study is to explore the method of IV conversion signal processing and feature detection with low noise and ultra-low distortion based on support vector machine (SVM) algorithm. According to the actual situation of photovoltaic power generation system, the IV conversion signal is processed and predicted by SVM algorithm to improve the accuracy and stability of current-voltage conversion. In the actual photovoltaic power generation system, an appropriate algorithm should be adopted to dynamically find out the maximum power point and make adaptive adjustment according to the changes of the external environment, so as to ensure the maximum power output of the system. Through the analysis of the experimental results, it can be found that the IV conversion model based on SVM has higher prediction accuracy and robustness than other algorithms, and can better understand and predict the dynamic behavior and performance of photovoltaic power generation system. This result fully proves the performance superiority of low noise and ultra-low distortion IV conversion technology based on SVM algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Social Work System Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Social systems theory is a research method of social work perspective. The theory emphasizes changing circumstances rather than psychological content. Based on ecosystem theory, this paper uses the perspective of community ecology and interpretive model to carry out practical research. In this paper, social work elements such as service objects, social workers, actions and habitat resources are systematically placed into the ecological niche of “subject”, “companion”, “connection” and “support”. Secondly, this paper makes a further comparative analysis based on four major issues of operability, accountability, relevance and legitimacy in the application process of theory and practice proposed by Payne. Finally, this paper designs the human social work system based on the computer big data. Then this paper introduces the process of system design and implementation by using UML design idea, integrating business function integration, information resource integration, business process integration and other elements. The practical results show that the system has achieved good application effect.

articleTitle: Chemical Experiment Aided Design System Based on Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Experimental teaching refers to the instructional stage of combining theoretical knowledge with practical activities, abstraction with concreteness, and direct and indirect. This teaching mode is more comprehensive, practical, direct and innovative than pure theory teaching. In this article, a instructional resource recommendation model of networked chemistry experiment instructional platform based on improved collaborative filtering (CF) algorithm is proposed. The user preferences are modeled and analyzed, and the obtained user model vectors are clustered, so as to realize individuation recommendation of chemistry experiment instructional resources driven by big data and provide support for networked chemistry teaching in universities. The results show that the recommended model of chemical experiment instructional resources in this article has lower error and higher recommendation accuracy. Compared with the traditional CF algorithm, the average absolute error (MAE) is reduced by 19.78% and the recall is increased by 24.56%. The comprehensive experimental results show that the recommended model of chemical experiment instructional resources in this article has high accuracy and low error performance, and can be applied to the network construction of chemical experiment teaching to provide technical support for the construction of chemical experiment aided design system.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Natural Disaster Data Processing and Analysis Methods Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In today’s society, the power grid, as one of the key infrastructure, plays a vital role in modern life and economic operation. However, with the continuous intensification of climate change, frequent natural disasters have become a major challenge for the stable operation of power grids. To address these challenges more effectively, this study is titled “Exploring Deep Learning Techniques for Processing and Analyzing Power Grid Natural Disaster Data.” The objective is to investigate the application of deep learning technology in handling and analyzing the extensive data generated by power grids during natural disaster events. This research aims to enhance the disaster response capabilities and operational stability of power grids.This study first focuses on the large amount of data generated by power grids when natural disasters occur. However, traditional data processing methods are often difficult to effectively mine valuable information from these data. Hence, this study introduces a data processing approach that relies on deep learning techniques. By building a neural network model with strong adaptability and high automatic learning ability, potential patterns and rules can be extracted from complex power grid data to realize intelligent data analysis and mining. This paper first introduces the theory of data deletion, including deletion mechanism and deletion mode; Secondly, the relevant methods of missing data filling are introduced, including GAN model and GAIN model. Then, the theory of intertemporal sequence correlation is introduced. Lastly, the missing data is imputed using the model proposed in this paper, and the obtained results are analyzed to validate the effectiveness of the model.In short, this study aims to use deep learning technology to mine useful information about power load and equipment status from power grid natural disaster data, so as to improve the power grid’s natural disaster response ability and operation stability. By developing intelligent data processing and analysis methods, this study anticipates offering novel ideas and solutions for power grid response during natural disasters. Consequently, it aims to enhance the overall social reliability and resilience of power supply, thereby promoting its improvement.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in the Early Warning System of Finance and Accounting Risks
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this paper, a systematic financial crisis early warning model is established by using the neural network method, which is used to evaluate and forecast the system risk situation in China. According to this warning information, the corresponding risk control strategy is given. Several main risk index KRI factors are studied by nonlinear mathematical method. And the RBF neural network is used for comprehensive danger warning. Through experimental simulation, it is concluded that the risk situation of China’s financial system is closely related to the risk of currency bank, macroeconomic trade, external shock and financial risk. This method has the advantages of small calculation error and fast convergence. This method can be popularized very well.

articleTitle: Research on Traceability of Fresh Agricultural Products Based on Association Rule Mining Algorithm in E-commerce Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Nowadays, food safety issues in society have entered the public’s field of vision, and the attention of key words such as green food, organic vegetables, etc. continues to heat up. The hidden trouble of traceability of agricultural products is directly related to the national economy and people’s livelihood and affects the development of China’s social economy. Traceability of agricultural products has become an urgent key research topic. When agricultural products are labeled as green and organic, with the increase of agricultural product prices, problems such as the safety, rationality and reliability of organic agricultural products appear. In the context of promoting the “Internet plus” modern agriculture, the requirement for improving the quality and safety level of agricultural products has further promoted the development of the traceability system of China’s agricultural products. Classification is an important analysis method in the field of data mining, and association rule mining is an important research direction in the field of data mining. As two highly active research fields in data mining, they have a certain similarity - mining highly correlated item sets. In this environment, the marketing methods in the field of agricultural products marketing in China have also been developed, which is more accurate than the traditional marketing model. “Internet + agriculture” is an important opportunity for the development of traditional agriculture by Internet technology. As a developing country with a large agricultural population, Internet + agriculture undoubtedly provides a direction for China’s agricultural modernization. Therefore, combining these two important technologies, that is, applying association rule mining to classification task, opens a new journey of data classification - Association classification. This paper mainly uses association rule mining algorithm to deeply study and discuss the traceability of fresh agricultural products under e-commerce mode.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Computer Vision Based SSL Detection Technology for Marine Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Computer vision has been widely used in the field of navigation safety, including ship identification, course prediction, and other applications, as a result of the fast development of pattern recognition and intelligent information processing technology. This has been made possible by the widespread adoption of computer vision technology. The sea sky line (SSL) is a linear interval that differentiates the area of the sky from the surface of the water. It is also an important reference in the perception of the marine environment, which enables vessels that are equipped with visual perception equipment to use visual technology perception equipment to obtain information about the environment around them. When contrasted with the environment of land, the environment of the sea surface is characterized by sudden shifts in the weather and the presence of noticeable waves. Consequently, there are still certain challenges involved in the process of detecting the SSL using computer vision technology. In this study, a comprehensive analysis and summary of the sea-sky line detection algorithms used by several modal cameras is presented.

articleTitle: Simulation of Prediction Model of College Students’ Employment Rate Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this paper, the simulation research on the prediction model of college students’ employment rate based on BPNN (BP neural network) is carried out, and the prediction model of college students’ employment rate is established. The neural network used in this paper has a threetier structure, and the employment data of college graduates from 2015 to 2021 is selected as training data for prediction. There are 4 input nodes, and the number of hidden layer nodes is determined to be 8; The output number is 1. The simulation results show that the difference between the output value of BPNN prediction model and the actual value is small, and the minimum absolute error is 0.154. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the model can be used to predict the employment quality of college students.

articleTitle: Design of Music Art Teaching Quality Evaluation System Based on Deep Convolution Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Art teaching is an art subject with strong practicality. Its teaching philosophy focuses on improving students’ musical knowledge, cultivating students’ musical singing ability and deepening students’ artistic aesthetic sentiment. Exploring a new teaching mode of music art major in colleges and universities has become an important issue that music educators in colleges and universities pay attention to. In this paper, based on the deep convolution neural network algorithm, the teaching quality of music art is further studied. The research shows that CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) is the first to achieve basic convergence. When the training rounds are 40, it has reached basic convergence, and the accuracy of the verification set can reach $65 \%$. And when the training rounds of AI (Artificial intelligence) are 70 and 60, the basic convergence of AI is achieved, and the accuracy of verification set is $58 \%$ and $60 \%$. It can be seen from the data in Figure 4 that the error rate of CNN is the lowest, followed by AI (Ant colony) and finally AC. From the above experimental results, it can be concluded that CNN has the best effect in evaluating the quality of music art teaching. The algorithm based on deep convolution neural network has a very important influence on the efficiency and quality of music art teaching. Therefore, music teachers should actively take effective measures to mobilize the atmosphere of music classroom learning, so as to achieve the purpose of improving the quality of music art teaching.

articleTitle: A Systematic Study of Oral Clinical Therapy Based on Computer 3D Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper introduces the repair algorithm based on computer 3D modeling. The algorithm is used to realize automatic repair of the model and finally get a completely closed tooth model. Secondly, a chamfer filling method based on normal vector was proposed, and the chamfer region of the crown data was identified by judging the Angle between the normal vector and the demolding direction. This reduces the manual chamfer filling workload; Then a template - based Laplacian model editing algorithm is proposed to realize the mapping from two - dimensional template to three dimensional model. Smooth editing effect is ensured by Laplace deformation. Finally, through the modular design of the above three algorithms into the data processing pipeline to develop a digital oral prototype system. The broad spectrum, accuracy and efficiency of the correlation algorithm are verified by different sample examples.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Assembly System for Aircraft Control System Parts Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The traditional assembly process of aircraft control system parts is mostly manual. Due to human factors and the complexity of parts, the assembly quality and efficiency may be difficult to guarantee. Based on this, this article proposes a design strategy of automatic assembly system for aircraft control system parts based on improved genetic algorithm (IGA). Through experiments, it is found that, compared with traditional genetic algorithm (GA), IGA shows higher global searching ability and efficiency when dealing with automatic assembly and feature detection of aircraft control system parts, and avoids falling into local optimal solution prematurely, and its output results are more consistent with the actual results. These results show that IGA has higher applicability and efficiency in solving such complex optimization problems. To sum up, this article compares and analyzes the performance of IGA and traditional GA in automatic assembly and feature detection of aircraft control system parts, and verifies the superiority of IGA. These conclusions have certain guiding significance for further optimizing the application of GA and other fields.

articleTitle: Research and Design of A Personalized Recommendation System for Ceramic Products Based on User Profiling and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of ecommerce and the rapid increase of product categories, it is difficult for users to choose suitable products in the face of a large amount of product information on the one hand, and the products cannot be accurately marketed to specific users on the other hand, and this phenomenon is particularly prominent in the marketing of niche products such as ceramic cultural and creative products. This paper designs an intelligent recommendation system for ceramic products based on user portrait technology, which can model the user and product characteristics, calculate the similarity between users and products through collaborative filtering algorithm, and perform clustering analysis on products and users, and better understand users’ needs, preferences and behavioral habits by analyzing user portraits to improve user experience and marketing effect. The recommendation system can dynamically store users’ real-time behavioral data and provide feedback on users’ real-time preferences, and as the system continues to run, the recommendation quality of the recommendation system gradually increases and becomes perfect. The design of this paper can effectively improve the marketing accuracy, reduce the marketing cost, explore potential customers, and provide a basis for decision making in the operation of ceramic cultural and creative products.

articleTitle: Research on Automotive Safety Based on Multi-Sensor Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the automotive safety research based on multi-sensor information fusion technology, which can integrate the information of multiple sensors to improve the accuracy and reliability to better support the safety control of the vehicle. This paper first introduces the application of sensor technology in the field of automotive safety, including radar, camera, lidar, etc. Then, the principle and implementation of multi-sensor information fusion technology are elaborated in detail, including data fusion, feature fusion and decision fusion. Finally, this paper discusses the application of multi-sensor information fusion technology in the field of automotive safety, such as vehicle status, driver behavior, traffic conditions and so on. In conclusion, this paper presents an automotive safety research study based on multi-sensor information fusion technology, aiming to improve vehicle safety performance and contribute to the development of the automotive industry.

articleTitle: 3DE Digital Platform for Electrical Distribution Design of Pumped Storage Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Pumped storage power plants have the advantages of environmental protection, fast response, and reusability, and their role has gradually been widely recognized and rapidly developed. In recent years, the rapid development of digital technology has led to an increasing demand for virtual reality. As an emerging technology, 3DE digital platform is gradually entering people’s vision. This platform can bring people into a completely different experience by generating a realistic virtual world in real-time. This article designs the electrical distribution of pumped storage power plants through the 3DE digital platform. The testing of the hydraulic turbine model of a pumped storage power plant showed that the simulation results of the turbine terminal voltage and the generator active power showed a smaller difference in the first swing curve, which was basically consistent. Only slight differences were observed in the following few swings, indicating that the hydraulic turbine model had little impact on electrical quantities during transient analysis of the power system. At the same time, the 3DE digital platform can predict future energy demand and store electricity in pumped storage tanks to supply electricity during peak hours and improve the stability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Operation System of Tourism Promoted by Computer Big Data E-Commerce Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the framework of JavaEE, Struts2, Spring, Ibatis and other three structural technologies are combined to build a multi-level B/S type tourism e-commerce platform. The integration and processing of the information in the network are realized at the two levels of network and EJB, and the optimal allocation is carried out. The user interaction is completed on the basis of Struts2. With Spring, you can enhance extensibility and reduce coupling between business components. A permanent data storage architecture based on abatis is proposed to reduce network load and improve system reliability. This project proposes a tourism e-commerce platform based on JavaEE framework. The system provides strong data support and fine operation for online and offline sales, customer service, analysis and decision-making.

articleTitle: Construction of Embedded Processing System for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Configuration Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: }In this article, PSO (Particle swarm optimization algorithm) algorithm is combined with embedded processing system, and an embedded processing system of PMSM (Permanent magnet synchronous motor) configuration based on PSO algorithm is constructed to realize efficient and accurate control of PMSM. The system consists of controller, driver, motor, etc. A set of optimal control parameters is found by PSO algorithm, and its feasibility and performance are verified by experiments. The results show that the algorithm can improve the control accuracy and robustness of the motor, while reducing the error and control time. The algorithm has higher search efficiency and accuracy, and better stability performance. Its stability is basically above 89%, and the average running time is about 0.3s. In addition, the adaptability and fast convergence of the algorithm make the system have better performance when dealing with complex and uncertain environments. These improvements provide strong support for the performance improvement and practical application of PMSM control system.

articleTitle: A Micro Robot Drilling Technology Based on Air Drill
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Micro robots can complete drilling operations in narrow areas that cannot be reached by people. This paper studies the selection of micro robot drilling tools and drilling parameters, and obtains the process parameters of micro robots suitable for aluminum alloy and composite material drilling. Finally, the air drill is selected as the drilling tool, which can meet the relevant requirements of aircraft manufacturing.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Supply Chain Risk Assessment System Based on Computer Supply Chain Risk Prevention and Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper explores the significance of supply chain risk management by introducing the concept of supply chain risk. Firstly, this paper constructs the normal delivery model, delayed delivery model and emergency risk transmission model of supply chain based on GERT network. Then this paper proposes a knowledge-based approach to supply chain reliability management under open-source cooperative mode. A supply chain risk management model (MABSCRM) based on multi-agent systems is developed. Identify sources of risk, measure risk characteristics and implement controls. An example is used to illustrate the reliability of an open-source supply chain support system. The study found that establishing a supply chain can help enterprises to evaluate the reliability risk of large-scale and complex software.

articleTitle: Analysis of Thermoelectric Coupling Characteristics of Typical Copper Fittings in UHV DC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of local overheating of the fittings in UHV DC Converter Station during the operation period, the typical fittings copper terminal connectors of HVDC converter station are taken as the research object, and its thermoelectric coupling characteristics are studied. The thermal-electrical coupling model of the copper terminal connectors is established by using the finite element method, and the temperature and current density distribution characteristics of the terminal connectors in the operating environment of the converter station are analyzed. The results show that under the condition of big current, the temperature of the overlapping parts of the terminal connectors is higher than other parts and the temperature of the center position of overlapping parts is highest. The temperature rise of the terminal connectors increases exponentially with time and tends to be stable. The current density of the overlapping parts of the terminal connectors is less than other parts, and the current density of its edge is greater than that of the middle part.

articleTitle: Network Parameter Configuration Based on Network Resource Combination
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this study, the researcher studied a method of network resource parameter configuration and the corresponding computer-readable storage media to obtain the number of devices that need to be adapted and the network resources of the network resource pool according to the request of network resource parameter configuration. The network resources in the network resource pool are the sum of the network resources used by the adapted devices during the statistical period. Select the target network resource parameters for each device to be adapted in the network resource parameter set according to the number of devices to be adapted and the network resource pool’s network resources. Obtain the network resource parameter combination so that the network resources in the network resource pool other than the network resource parameter combination do not exceed the preset network resource threshold. Configure the network resource parameters for the equipment to be adapted based on the network resource parameter combination, then, based on the network resource parameter combination, set network resource parameters to be adapted to the device. This scheme can greatly improve the flexibility and efficiency of network resource parameter configuration.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Control System for Self-Driving Automobile Trajectory Based on BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: SDA (Self-driving automobile) has more precise control ability than traditional human driving, and its control of acceleration, deceleration and steering is more precise, and it has faster response ability than human driving. Because the relationship between input and interference factors on output is quite complex, and it is a high-order nonlinear system, and the uncertainty of internal parameters makes it very difficult to choose a suitable modeling method for vehicle system. In this paper, an optimal design method based on BPNN (BP neural network) is adopted to design the intelligent control system of SDA trajectory. GA (Genetic Algorithm) and batch normalization method are used to improve the neural network (NN). The output of the network acts on the PID controller, and the control parameters of PID are adjusted by NN. The simulation results show that the maximum lateral error is 0.23 m, and the trajectory obtained is basically consistent with the trajectory obtained from the test, which can meet the requirements of vehicle safety and obstacle avoidance. When the speed of the vehicle is accelerated from $10 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ to $30 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, it takes about 5 s for the vehicle to reach the predetermined speed, which meets the error requirements of vehicle speed control. The results show that SDA trajectory intelligent control system based on BPNN algorithm can reduce vehicle sideslip and improve vehicle driving stability.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Tourism Marketing Management System Based on Mobile end of Computer Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The technical route of this study starts from the background of smart tourism. Then the theory of tourism intelligent marketing management system is constructed based on the process of information system construction. The overall framework structure of the system 113N closed loop is constructed. Then this paper designs the intelligent function module of the system. According to the database demand analysis to establish the tourism intelligent marketing management data resource structure. In this way, the construction of intelligent DMS theory system is completed. Finally, the design and implementation of the website and mobile terminal of DMS. The smart application of mobile terminal is realized by combining location service and travel information push.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Tutors Based on Dialogue Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Over the course of the past several years, Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning researchers have grown more interested in the subject of Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS).The primary purpose of ITS is to facilitate language learning by facilitating voice interaction via speech recognition and speech synthesis technologies and evaluating learners’ oral expression using language models. In this study, we examine the history of ITS’s evolution as well as its present research state and potential future possibilities. First, a brief overview of ITS’s past development is provided, followed by an examination of its primary application domains. Second, a discussion of some of the most important technologies utilized by ITS is presented. These technologies include voice recognition, speech synthesis, language modeling, conversation management, and learning management. In the final part of this article, we will go over some of the next developments in ITS, such as cross-language learning, multimodal interaction, and tailored learning.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Campus Data Governance Platform Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the application and promotion of big data technology in colleges and universities, the problem of data governance has gradually become prominent: many colleges and universities have no overall data standards, lack of data verification, and problem data are constantly deposited, resulting in the failure or even error of big data analysis in supporting leadership decision-making. At the same time, in the smart campus environment, the application system becomes more micro-service and mobile, the pressure of data exchange in the data sharing and exchange platform increases exponentially, and the difficulty and workload of data exchange management by the data management department increase rapidly. The traditional data exchange and sharing platform for data exchange management has become increasingly unsuitable for the new business needs. Universities store a large amount of data resources in teaching, management, and service work, especially with the advent of the big data era. The data volume has increased from MB at the beginning to GB and then to TB. Many universities have reached the $P B$ level of data, and it is easy to reach the $Z B$ level in the near future. Through the investigation and analysis of the data management and application status of a provincial university, this paper proposes an effective solution for campus data governance based on the data center, which improves the data utilization rate and provides a comprehensive and accurate data foundation for the school in information query, intelligent decision-making, data mining, etc.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Network Multimedia English Language Teaching Model Based on Corpus
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Modern corpus is the database of real language electronic texts. Users can extract all the sentences containing keywords or structures from the corpus through the retrieval program, make structural comparison and word analysis, and summarize language phenomena. The combination of corpus and multimedia provides a huge information database for teaching. Because of its convenient access, it greatly reduces the time and workload of educators in preparing lessons, and can also promote learners’ autonomous learning. This paper presents an assessment model of English language teaching (ELT) based on weighted reasoning model, and its effectiveness is verified by comparison with other assessment algorithms. Then, this assessment model is used to analyze the significance of corpus in the construction of network multimedia ELT model. The results show that, compared with the traditional back propagation neural network (BPNN), the proposed teaching assessment model has higher prediction accuracy and recall rate, which are increased by $19.69 \%$ and $16.88 \%$ respectively. Therefore, this method is feasible for ELT assessment. From the assessment of instructional effect, it can be seen that the application of corpus in the innovation of network multimedia ELT has a remarkable effect.

articleTitle: Design of Personalized Teaching Recommendation System in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, students mainly use search technology to find learning materials on the learning resource platform, and the most commonly used is keyword search. This passive search can’t actively push the learning resources that customers are interested in according to the characteristics of students’ preferences, which affects the efficiency of customers’ selection of value resources. In this regard, this paper attempts to design a personalized teaching recommendation system in higher vocational colleges based on decision tree algorithm. It is proved by experiments that in the test of calculating the similarity of resources in the personalized teaching recommendation system established in this paper, the weights of stories told by managers, professionalism and professionalism are almost equal, and the average values can reach 0.716 and 0.748 respectively, while the weights of leadership and leadership art are 0.363. Students with similar learning interests are grouped by decision tree algorithm, and there are likely to be valuable resources for other individuals in the resource set of each individual in the group. Recommending the resources of the same group of students to learners in personalized teaching recommendation system will certainly improve the utilization efficiency of learning resources.

articleTitle: A Cost Mining Pattern of Non-Financial Data in Operate Accounting Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In recent years, a significant trend of enterprise acting estimate is to introduce eight non-financial quota in the acting estimate index system, the typical representative of which is the balanced score estimate method of Kaplan and Norton. Aiming at the problem that corporate financial crisis early warning is difficult to be true and accurate, a fuzzy early warning pattern of corporate financial crisis based on nonfinancial quota is proposed. Due to the needs of corporate strategic operate, acting estimate, and incentive design, more and more companies have chosen non-financial quota as part of their acting estimate quota, such as product mass, market share, customer satisfaction and innovation ability etc. However, there is no mature method for how to select nonfinancial quota. This paper adopts the method of machine learning. As machine learning algorithms are applied to public fields such as finance, anti-terrorism, taxation, justice, medical care, insurance, etc., algorithms not only bring a lot of progress to the economy and society, but also determine the well-being of citizens.

articleTitle: Financial Product Management Model and Optimization Based on Service-Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: When financial companies undertake different capital banks, they are faced with a variety of personalized constraints, resulting in the failure of loan review, long loan transaction review time and low pass rate. The financial cost decision-making system can control the capital cost of the company by putting the audit limit in front, designing a personalized constraint rule set, improving the audit pass rate and controlling the investment proportion of the capital bank. Financial product portfolio is an important part of financial product management and financial management. This paper studies the model and optimization of financial product portfolio. The objective function of this problem is to maximize the capital output rate of shareholders’ equity, and the decision variables are financial leverage and debt structure. The model and optimization of macro financial products are analyzed and studied. The objective function of this problem is to maximize the profit of shareholders’ net asset value, and the decision variables are financial leverage and debt structure. The construction process of financial product management model and uncertain scenario conditions for optimization is given. Finally, this paper gives a case simulation of the change of financial leverage and the profit of net asset value under different debt structures. According to the actual use of the system, the financial cost decision-making system meets the functional design expectations, effectively solves the bottleneck problem of financial loan transaction process, improves the audit pass rate, shortens the transaction waiting time, and reasonably allocates the capital cost. The system has high reliability and has the ability of service degradation and disaster recovery. It adopts a variety of tools such as fuse, current limiting, monitoring and alarm to ensure the safe and reliable operation of the system, and has good application value.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Optimization of Russian Spoken Wisdom Education System Based on Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Language is the link of excellent civilization exchange and inheritance, all cooperation and integration among all ethnic groups, regions and countries. As two big countries on the international stage, China and Russia play an irreplaceable role in international affairs. With such a large-scale Russian talent training team, its basic teaching mode is worthy of academic thinking and research. Especially since 2019, Russian teachers in colleges and universities across the country have ushered in a new “big exam”. How to take the initiative to turn crisis into opportunity, do a good job in teaching, improve teaching methods and form a benign teaching reflection is an important mission of Russian teaching. Therefore, how to correctly use different oral testing methods, including using more scientific and objective scoring standards to complete the test, is an important issue that should always be taken seriously and continuously improved in the teaching and testing of relevant courses for each grade of Russian major. The main research direction of this article is to improve the measurement method of user similarity, refine user behavior, and combine factors such as user learning goals to improve recommendation accuracy. This article elaborates in detail on the connotation, methods, platforms, teaching reflection, and promotion of student remote learning models of online teaching, in order to provide reference and guidance for online Russian teaching in China.

articleTitle: The Method of Data Quality Acquisition for Intelligent Watt hour Meter
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
