abstract: This paper mainly studies a collection method of product quality information for enterprise intelligent watt hour meter, which is mainly divided into the following processes: the information collection unit collects the product quality information submitted by the workshop; Collect the product quality information of the workshop or production device in real time through the intranet edge collection port; After comparing the product quality information submitted by the workshop with its own product quality data, if there is any error in the result, the product quality data shall prevail; Upload the product quality data after comparative measurement, and the platform receives, analyzes and transmits the product quality data according to the interface protocol; The platform stores the product quality information of each workshop of the enterprise, and summarizes the product quality data of the workshop and the enterprise at the same time; And access the platform through the client; In case of system failure, the data collection unit can collect and store the quality data offline, and temporarily store the collected quality data in the form of the enterprise’ s own database; After the system is reset, the data collection unit will upload the stored data to the intranet server.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Platform Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper studies a distribution network platform based on big data analysis, including: cloud storage module, which is responsible for data storage, backup and query. The data management center has various professional data centers; The data storage module is used to preprocess the data that users need to upload on the client; The encryption and decryption module is used to encrypt or decrypt the remaining data to be stored in cloud storage according to the optimized access control security policy; The storage control module is used to store the data that users need to upload to the corresponding physical storage device; The security management module is used to uniformly monitor and manage the security of each system. The application of the invention facilitates the unified management of data, improves work efficiency and saves costs; The retrieval algorithm combining directory retrieval and search engine can obtain data quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Study on Tunnel Computer Monitoring System Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the acceleration of modernization and upgrading of China’s construction industry, the construction of the whole industrial chain for the integration of construction information and construction industry demand is increasingly obvious. The construction industry urgently needs to enhance the ability of construction informationization command and dispatch coordination management in the construction field, especially in the integrated management of tunnel engineering. In view of the above problems, domestic and foreign experts in the same industry have actively implemented the corresponding theoretical and practical research. However, most of them have not formed a complete set of Tunnel Engineering Information Integrated Management Program, the key is not to achieve the efficient integration of tunnel engineering information model and production practice. In order to solve the above problems, this paper carried out practical research and application work. Through theoretical research and practical application, an effective implementation method of tunnel engineering informationization management is formed, which makes up for the difficulties of current tunnel engineering informationization management.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Online Precision Marketing System Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The market competition of online marketing is still intensifying. In order to achieve their own competitive advantage, related online marketing enterprises and platforms must deepen consumer research in order to provide effective basis for the formulation of related marketing strategies. This topic collects relevant data by tracking each user, then analyzes the characteristics of Internet user data, finds out the sticky attribute set, uses the improved ID3 algorithm to classify Internet user data, and digs out potential members, false members and sticky members of Internet users. Then sort out and design the database and system, define the system function, and develop an online precision marketing system based on DT (Decision tree) algorithm. The system test shows that the basic function of the system has passed the test, and most problems have been solved well. After the test, the average response time of the user’s request is 0.1 seconds, and the maximum response time is 0.5 seconds. The results show that the improved ID3 algorithm can effectively improve the computational efficiency of the algorithm, improve the bias problem of the ID3 algorithm, and improve the accuracy of the algorithm. The feasibility and reliability of the online precision marketing system are verified, and it has high application value.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Fish-Like Energy Harvesting Device
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In order to collect abundant ocean energy, a fishlike energy harvesting device is designed in this paper. Firstly, the mechanical structure of the fish-like energy harvesting device is analyzed in terms of shape design, and the mechanical structure is determined to consist of the body, energy capture device, and rudder device, and the model is established by Solidworks 3D modeling software. Then, the electronic control system of the bionic fish energy harvesting device was designed. The Arduino development board was used as the main control module, and the selection of relevant devices was introduced to realize the integration of the electronic control system, so as to achieve the purpose of marine energy harvesting. Finally, the hydrodynamic analysis of the shape of the fish-like energy harvesting device is carried out by applying Ansys Fluent software, and the analysis results show that the pressure distribution around the body is more uniform and the body structure is better. The design study of this paper verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the fish-like energy harvesting device.

articleTitle: 3D Design of Cartoon Characters Based on VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology in China, a variety of advanced technologies have been gradually derived. VR technology and 3D animation design technology are two typical advanced technologies. There are certain advantages and characteristics between the two technologies, and they are also widely used in the field of industry development. For example, 3D animation design technology is generally applied to film and television design, and VR technology generally plays a role in computer application and development. The 3D design of traditional cartoon characters is affected by the traditional evolutionary computing 3D technology. The design of cartoon characters has certain shortcomings, which affect the shaping of cartoon characters. This greatly improves the production efficiency and the accuracy of character animation. Make character animation more smooth, natural and real. In recent years, according to the demand of animation industry, domestic and foreign animators have paid more attention to this aspect. This is not an isolated technology. 3D character animation is closely related to many fields and technologies. With the continuous development of animation industry, 3 D animation technology as an advanced technology with the background of the times has been paid more and more attention. This paper studies the 3D design of cartoon characters under the background of VR technology, and puts forward a feasible scheme of 3D design combination of cartoon characters under VR technology.

articleTitle: User Behavior Analysis and Prediction Algorithm Design of E-commerce Platform Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: From the consumer’s point of view, e-commerce is online shopping, which is deeply loved by consumers because of its convenient price comparison, unlimited commodity selection, rapidity and convenience. Faced with a large number of EC (Electronic Commerce) website shopping users, it is particularly difficult to analyze users’ behaviors. Therefore, this paper designs the user behavior analysis and prediction algorithm of e-commerce platform based on big data analysis, and through experimental analysis, it can be found that the types of books purchased by students in traditional bookstores are also different from those purchased online. Students often buy exam guidance books in traditional bookstores, accounting for an average of 47.51% of all books; The most frequently purchased books in online bookstores are exam counseling, accounting for an average of 82.61% of all books. This shows that the algorithm designed in this paper can provide marketing decisions for EC websites, reduce marketing costs, guard against operational risks, expand the scale of EC users and the successful shopping rate, enhance EC benefits and enhance market competitiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Graphic Design Color Matching Optimization Algorithm Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The color scheme of interactive graphic design often needs to draw inspiration from the color styles of some images during the design process. Flat images are an important conceptual source for product color schemes. Image matching has become an indispensable technology in modern information processing and is also widely used in other fields. Therefore, conducting research on relevant algorithms in image matching technology has profound significance for the development of computer vision. This article optimizes the color matching algorithm for interactive graphic design based on RL (Reinforcement Learning). The research results show that the average matching accuracy of GA (Genetic Algorithm), CF (Collaborative Filtering), and our algorithm for each image is 86.24%, 90.47%, and 95.02%, respectively. From the test results, it can be found that the accuracy of the algorithm in this paper is the highest among them. From Figure 5, it can be seen that the average matching time of the three algorithms: GA, CF, and our algorithm for each image is 27.51, 24.37, and 6.54, respectively. From the test results, it can be found that the average matching time of the algorithm in this paper is the shortest. RL can effectively express the global structural information between image pixels.

articleTitle: Simulation of Fault Recovery Optimization Decision Model for Power Distribution Network Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this article, the simulation of optimal decision model for fault recovery of power distribution network (PDN) based on ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm is mainly studied. Firstly, aiming at the shortcomings of traditional ACO algorithm, this article improves it, introduces elite strategy and dynamically adjusts pheromone volatilization rate to improve the search ability and robustness of the algorithm. Then, an optimized decision-making model of PDN fault recovery is established by using the improved ACO algorithm. The objective function is to minimize the fault recovery time and the power outage loss, and the topological structure and operation constraints of the PDN are considered. Finally, the proposed algorithm and model are verified and analyzed by simulation experiments. Experiments show that the accuracy of the algorithm can reach $94 \%$ and the error is only 1.35. In addition, compared with GA and AFSA, ACO algorithm improves the solution accuracy by more than $10 \%$ and shortens the solution time by more than $30 \%$. The comparative experimental results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed algorithm and model in PDN fault recovery. The research results have important theoretical and practical significance for improving the efficiency and effect of PDN fault recovery, and provide a new solution and method for other similar problems.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Equipment Health State Based on Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the whole life cycle management of equipment, how to accurately evaluate and scientifically monitor the health status of equipment through the existing accumulated reliability data has always been an urgent problem to be solved in equipment management. Based on the fault data accumulated in the history of a communication equipment, this paper uses time series analysis method to predict and analyze the running state of the equipment in the whole life cycle management process, effectively improving the efficiency of equipment management.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Power Grid Investment Demand Forecasting Model Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s national economy, the increasing demand for electricity in the whole society, and the firepower of the 13th Five-Year Plan, the investment demand of China’s power grid is constantly increasing. Accurate and effective forecasting of power grid investment (PGI) demand can not only help to make overall plans for funds, rationally arrange the investment of power grid construction funds, reduce capital costs and economic risks, but also effectively improve the operation status of grid corporation, which is crucial to ensuring the steady development of grid corporation and promoting the investment planning and construction process of grid corporation. In this paper, data mining is used as a means, and the PGI demand forecasting model is used as the research object. When the investment demand and investment capacity do not match, the grid corporation’ investment capacity and investment demand are coordinated and optimized. A new forecasting model of PGI demand based on grey clustering algorithm is proposed, and through empirical research, the validity, applicability and superiority of the model proposed in this paper for the prediction of PGI demand are proved, which provides a new method for the prediction of PGI demand.

articleTitle: Quantitative Economics Model Research Based on Computer Simulation Digitization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper considers the economic system as a kind of birth and death process. Firstly, this paper establishes the control model of the economic system at the macro level based on the actual economic analysis and prediction model. The continuous model facilitates theoretical study. The discrete model is convenient for computer simulation. Then, on the basis of this control model, we find the expression form of minimum asset accumulation rate which is necessary for the sustainable development of national economy. Experiments on the computer prove that both estimation methods are very robust and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Cold Chain Logistics Risk of System Dynamics Model under the COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Since the global epidemic of COVID-19, a number of cluster COVID-19 cases caused by cold chain have been reported around the world, causing new risks and crises for cold chain logistics enterprises in China. System dynamics have significant advantages in handling complex causality and dynamically studying nonlinear structured systems. Attaching more importance to epidemic risk, and incorporate it into the cold chain logistics risk management system is is necessary. Establish cold chain logistics risk system dynamics model, and Dalian, “Chinese first cold chain base”, was taken as an example for simulation. Study the epidemic risk, main risk, environmental risk and operational risk in the process of single cold chain logistics, and the impact of risk control strategies at different stages on risk control effect, risk control cost and performance of cold chain logistics. Simulation results show that although the epidemic risk level is not like the environmental risk, the epidemic risk grows rapidly over time, surpassing the subject and operational risk level in the later stage; but taking effective risk control measures can still reasonably control various risks and ensure the performance of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research and Design of University Teaching Assistant System Based on Fusion Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: By using the network aided teaching system, universities can well connect classroom teaching and afterschool counseling. Besides providing a new way for teaching, they also unify the teaching resources within the school, laying a good foundation for the sharing and inheritance of teaching resources. In this paper, the research and design of college teaching assistant system based on PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) is carried out. The main design content of this system is the design of server Web application service, which adopts layered software architecture. An improved PSO based on multi-strategy fusion is proposed for course scheduling design. Random factors are introduced to dynamically adjust the inertia weight, and particles are guided by the fitness function value to make better search. The test results show that the multi-strategy fusion PSO can generate the most usable timetables when the same timetables are generated, that is, the satisfaction of meeting the requirements is high, so the multi-strategy fusion PSO has certain usability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Industrial Robot Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the background of artificial intelligence, it is necessary to study the control system of industrial robots. Based on the research of the industrial machine control system, enhance the students master and use of industrial robots, optimize the robot part device, prolong service life, saving labor costs and raw material costs, reduced working hours, increase product core competitiveness in the market, to strengthen exchanges and cooperation in the field of more and more enterprises.

articleTitle: Construction and Operation of Construction Safety Monitoring Mode Based on Intelligent Video Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the management level in the construction field, the coordination between the safety, practicability and economy of the project entity and the surrounding environment is particularly important. The preparation of a good construction schedule and its full application plays a very important role in the construction process are essential to achieve the above goals. Construction enterprises are the main body of management of construction projects., the requirements for modernization are also increasing. Economic development is closely related to construction projects, so the requirements for its safety management system are getting higher and higher. With the establishment of the market economic system and the continuous in-depth development of the market economy, the reform of the construction industry and the construction management system has been deepened, and the production methods and organizational structure of construction enterprises have also undergone profound changes. The management system has been basically formed. The method used in this paper is intelligent video analysis. The application of this system in the field of disaster prevention and mitigation can not only promote the upgrading of widely used video surveillance systems, but also realize information fusion processing among various means based on video.

articleTitle: Study of Smart Tourism Based on Holographic Optics and AR Technology in the 5G Era--- Taking the big wild goose pagoda as an example
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the tertiary industry, the tourism industry is facing problems while it continues to flourish. This article takes The Big Wild Goose Pagoda as an example, and briefly describes how to combine holographic optics technology and AR technology in the 5G era, to cleverly take advantage of holographic optics and AR technology to build a 5G base station-based smart tourism system, an infrared personnel diversion, The smart tourism industry of interactive travel and smart services on the mobile phone is in progress.

articleTitle: Development of Online Teaching Platform for Art Design Specialty Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, with the rapid growth of network and informatization, art education and network information technology have been combined, and informatization education reform and development plans have been introduced one after another, and the pace of education modernization has been accelerated. In this article, DL algorithm is used to model and analyze user preferences, and the obtained user model vectors are clustered. In order to facilitate the recommendation of online instructional resources tailored for art design majors through the utilization of big data, this aims to offer substantial backing for the development of an online teaching platform dedicated to art design education. The results show that the deep learning (DL) algorithm in this article is significantly higher than the traditional collaborative filtering (CF) algorithm in recommending online instructional resources for art design. Therefore, it is of positive significance to apply the personalized recommendation model of instructional resources for art design specialty to the construction of online teaching platform for art design specialty. The creation and utilization of an online teaching platform present a novel trajectory for evolving the conventional teaching methodology in the field of art design. This, in turn, establishes a robust groundwork for enhancing the overall quality of online education within the art design specialty.

articleTitle: A Higher Education Information Management System Based on Digital Twin Technology and Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology and the continuous advancement of school education reform, the development of school education management information has become the inevitable trend of education management reform and development in the information age. With the advent of the Internet of everything world, the new generation of information technology and entity are deeply integrated, as an important frontier of information technology “digital twin technology” has become the focus. Digital twin technology refers to the use of information technologies such as the Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence and virtual reality to fully realize the digital expression of entities in the virtual world and form an information ecosystem of close-loop operation and intelligent decision-making with entities. In this paper, based on the actual development of colleges and universities, relying on the “big data basis” and “modeling ecosystem” of digital twin technology, combined with artificial intelligence algorithm, the digital twin technology is innovatively applied in the informatization of college education management. On the basis of multi-dimensional and multi-modal data collection and mining of college education management, a set of digital twin model of university education management informatization is constructed, and the model is applied in scene. By creating the digital twin education management system, we can realize the new mode of intelligent visual education management and promote the development of education management informatization.

articleTitle: Research on Kernel Entropy Component Analysis Algorithm and Its Application in Chemical Process Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The chemical production process is complex and often uses extreme conditions such as high temperature and pressure. Raw materials and products have characteristics such as flammability, explosion, toxicity, and corrosiveness, and the production equipment presents large-scale and continuous characteristics. This article further studies the kernel entropy component analysis algorithm and its application in chemical process monitoring. Firstly, a brief introduction was given to the monitoring of multivariate statistical processes. Secondly, the algorithm of kernel entropy component analysis and the specific steps of its application to chemical process monitoring were introduced. Finally, simulation experiments show that KECA (Kernel Entropy Component Analysis) can effectively detect step changes in the system caused by faults for a long time, while the two single parameter KECA models cannot effectively detect this fault for a long time. The main reason for this phenomenon is that the closed-loop control within the system can reduce the impact of the fault, while the single parameter KECA model is difficult to continuously detect faults, and its statistics are always below the confidence limit. It can be seen that the KECA algorithm for chemical process fault monitoring is effective, providing a new method for process monitoring methods.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Transmission Line Sag Based on Theoretical Mechanics
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Sag, as one of the critical parameters relating to the operation and maintenance of overhead transmission lines, directly impacts their safe and stable operation. Various factors, such as line operating load, conductor temperature, stress, overlying ice thickness on the conductor, and surrounding wind speed, can cause fluctuations in the line sag. This paper addresses the issue of overhead transmission line sag by conducting a stress analysis of conductors, proposing a sag calculation method, verifying its accuracy through conductor sag tests, and analyzing the impact of span and conductor temperature on sag. The results revealed that four parameters are required for sag calculation, namely the lowest point stress of the conductor, the unit linear load of the conductor, the angle of elevation between suspension points, and the span. The lowest point stress of the conductor requires solving the equation of state for the conductor, whereas other parameters can be directly acquired from the specific conditions of the transmission line project. As the span increases, the conductor sag increases continuously, and the same holds true for the increase in the conductor sag with temperature.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Courtyard Landscape Modeling Technology Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm and BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the development of Internet information technology in China, the construction industry also began to abandon the traditional manual drawing, calculation and design methods and use the 3D courtyard landscape modeling technology for the design of 3D view or model of a project. At the same time, the application process of BIM Technology in this course is studied, so as to promote the integration of BIM Technology and 3D courtyard landscape modeling technology, realize the optimization of teaching process and teaching effect, and improve students’ ability of architectural engineering drawing recognition and BIM Technology Application. In order to promote the digital and integrated development of large-scale engineering projects, and improve the work efficiency and quality of construction project design and construction. Combining BIM technology with 3D courtyard landscape modeling technology and geographic database, building BIM model is established to promote the innovation and development of urban 3D modeling technology. At the same time, building BIM model can be embedded into BIM model of urban planning project, which runs through the whole life cycle of the project, providing an efficient and convenient means of informatization for urban planners and managers.

articleTitle: Modeling Method for Complex Chemical Processes Using Hybrid DNA Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the modeling of complex chemical process, it is often needed to consider multiple factors and constraints at the same time, which makes the solution of the problem more complicated and difficult. Aiming at the modeling problem of complex chemical process, this article studies the GA of hybrid DNA computing, and proposes a variety of new operators and hybrid DNA genetic algorithm (HDGA) with new operators. The proposed HDGA is applied to the modeling of complex chemical processes. Compared with the traditional GA, the superiority and effectiveness of this algorithm in solving complex chemical process modeling problems are verified. Through experiments, it is found that HDGA has obvious advantages in modeling and optimization of complex chemical processes, with faster solving speed and higher solving accuracy. Compared with the traditional GA, HDGA can make better use of the structural information of the problem, so as to search for a better solution in the global scope. In addition, HDGA has the advantages of improving the solution accuracy, which makes it play an important role in the sustainable development of chemical industry.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Piano Teaching Management System Based on Clustering Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Music is an art form that can reflect life and convey emotion. Music can help people express emotion, release emotion and improve people’ s aesthetic ability. It is one of the eight major arts in the world. Nowadays, most colleges and universities have set up music majors in order to meet the needs of talents. Piano course is one of the important courses of music majors. At the same time, with the continuous advancement of national intelligence, more and more schools pay more and more attention to the scientific and standardized level of piano room intelligent management. By analyzing the present situation of the traditional management system of music education piano room in colleges and universities, the realization technology and basic functions of the intelligent management system of music education piano room are designed. Combined with the current music education and teaching practice, the application advantages of the intelligent management system of music education piano room are summarized, so as to effectively reduce the management cost of piano room in colleges and promote the healthy and stable development of music teaching management. At present, there are still some problems in piano teaching for music majors in colleges and universities, which restrict the development of piano teaching and students’ progress. Therefore, in order to make the piano teaching of music majors in colleges and universities more in line with the needs of the times, we should improve the teaching management system, innovate the teaching content, realize the teaching reform and train more music majors.

articleTitle: Research on Data Privacy Calculation and Data Traceability Technology for Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of user privacy leakage and calculation inefficiency in the process of real-time data aggregation and uploading of power monitoring systems, this paper proposes a research solution for data privacy calculation and data traceability of power monitoring systems. The data privacy calculation and data traceability research solution applies the big data processing technology to realize the optimized design of the system network security monitoring system. By constructing a system database and analyzing the operation mode of the power monitoring system network with the support of hardware devices and data, the real-time network data is collected and processed by using big data technology. The simulation results show that the scheme can effectively improve the security and reliability of the power system network security on both the network side of the power monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on Social Network Marketing Strategy Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As the pace of social life is getting faster and faster, people’s social space is getting smaller and smaller, and social networking sites appear to meet people’s social needs. People maintain a great deal of attention to social networking platforms, with more and more users of social networking, and the click rate is also increasing. The development of social networks brought about by the development of network information technology not only broadens people’s communication, but also facilitates the transmission and communication of information between people, and at the same time brings a new marketing method, namely social network marketing. If social networking sites want to achieve their own long-term development, they need to do a good job in network services and maintain user relationships, and innovate a feasible and stable profit model, so as to promote business development. The Apriori algorithm is used in this paper. The main idea of the algorithm is to obtain high-dimensional frequent itemsets through low-dimensional frequent itemsets by layer-by-layer iteration. Based on the new data structure, it improves the connection method for generating candidate itemsets.

articleTitle: Development of College Teaching Software Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In order to make up for the shortcomings of engineering experimental teaching and actively respond to the call of the Ministry of Education to promote the reform of experimental teaching, and make full use of VR (Virtual Reality) technology under the background of the development of the times, this paper carries out the research on the development and application of efficient teaching software based on VR technology. Establish the VR teaching software based on 3DS MAX, and the basic platform resources are based on 3DS MAX, including all the underlying codes, prefabricated parts, models, rendering material balls, etc. that support the whole project. The configuration file can modify the parameters of menu configuration, function configuration and system configuration, so as to change the software implementation effect. The interaction mode of the system is mainly based on the physical control operation interaction and the object picking interaction. To realize the interaction with the virtual scene, the objects in the virtual scene need to make corresponding actions. The application results show that about 87% students want teachers to use VR courseware for teaching, which verifies the practicability of this teaching software.

articleTitle: Simulation of Multi-objective Low-carbon Economic Scheduling Model Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the global warming, energy and environmental problems have become increasingly prominent, and the problem of excessive CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission has attracted wide attention from all countries in the world. As a renewable energy, wind power has the characteristics of zero emission and wide sources, but the problem of abandoning wind and absorbing it hinders the development of wind power. Because the quality of scheduling strategy affects the resource utilization rate and job execution efficiency in cloud environment to a great extent, and the jobs scheduled by scheduling algorithms in homogeneous cloud environment are usually independent of each other, which obviously cannot meet the growing and widely used trend of cloud computing, it is very necessary to develop a workflow job scheduling algorithm that can adapt to different resource requirements or depend on each other in large-scale heterogeneous cloud environment. This article first introduces the basic concepts and optimization algorithms of economic dispatch involving wind farms, including the establishment of objective functions and the selection of constraints, commonly used mathematical models for dynamic economic dispatch in power systems, commonly used evolutionary algorithms, and multi-objective optimization models. Finally, a numerical simulation was conducted to analyze the economic benefits and emission reduction effects of using heat storage devices to dissipate wind power in the carbon market environment, as well as the impact of different carbon trading prices on the system’s CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission reduction.

articleTitle: Simulation of Power System Fault Detection and Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The reliability and stability of power system are very important to modern society. However, faults in the power system may lead to power supply interruption, loss and potential security risks. Therefore, it is urgent to develop an efficient fault detection and prediction model for power system. The purpose of this study is to explore the method based on deep learning to improve the security and reliability of power system. In this study, the recurrent neural network (RNN) is used to train and test the simulation data of power system. In addition, the time series characteristics of different fault lines or different fault States are learned through attention mechanism, thus accelerating the efficiency of network learning. The research results show that deep learning has great potential in power system fault detection, which can effectively capture the complex characteristics of power system and improve the accuracy of fault detection. The model based on deep learning can help power companies identify potential faults in advance, thus reducing power outage time and losses. Power system fault detection and prediction models based on deep learning provide powerful tools for improving the reliability and security of power systems. However, the successful application of these models requires comprehensive data support and continuous performance monitoring and improvement.

articleTitle: Network Monitoring and Performance Optimization of Large-scale Distributed System Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper aims to discuss the network monitoring and performance optimization of large-scale distributed systems based on big data algorithm. In this paper, firstly, the network monitoring data of large-scale distributed systems are collected and processed and analyzed by using big data technology. By digging deeply into the useful information in these data, the state characteristics and behavior patterns of the system operation can be obtained. Secondly, the multi-dimensional index and machine learning algorithm are combined to cluster and classify the data to identify the root causes of network delay, congestion and failure. Finally, the optimization algorithm is used to rationally configure and manage the network resources to realize the performance optimization of the system. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the influence of network delay, congestion and failure, and improve the availability and performance of the system. Compared with traditional monitoring and performance optimization methods, the method proposed in this paper has higher accuracy, robustness and strong adaptability. This study can also provide some reference for other similar problems.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Intelligent Tourism City Navigation System Based on Computer 3D Panoramic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The design and development of tourism intelligent navigation system platform. The overall structure of the design system includes the tourism information intelligent recommendation module, the tourism itinerary planning module, the tourism information resource library and the data mining processing module. The data mining module of the system through six spatial data mining processes, in-depth mining of tourism information that tourists are interested in, accelerate the speed of tourism data mining. The distribution data of tourists in tourist attractions is obtained by wireless sensor network. According to the categories, personal preferences, characteristics and needs of tourists and other information to provide intelligent and personalized tourism user information management services, intelligent travel planning services and intelligent navigation, rescue, etc.

articleTitle: Research on Interior Decoration Effect Drawing Modeling System Based on 3DMAX Software Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a virtual reality system based on 3DMAX, which solves the problem that the design scheme and effect cannot be directly reflected in traditional home decoration work. The overall framework of the building interior decoration management system is designed, and the storage of decoration results is studied by introducing rays to realize the selection of objects. Then design the indoor environment based on the point cloud data processing technology. After the modeling is completed, the model is converted into DAE format and imported into lumion for rendering. The practical application proves that the system can effectively improve the efficiency of home decoration design and the quality of design scheme.

articleTitle: Construction of Public Management Dynamic Coordination System Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Although fuzzy control has many advantages, from the point of view of practical engineering application, there are still many unsolved problems in fuzzy control. Among them, there are many design factors of fuzzy controller. When the controlled object is complex, it is difficult to choose and adjust the design factors of fuzzy controller. In order to avoid the complex debugging of parameters in fuzzy controller design and obtain the best control performance, swarm intelligence algorithm is often used to optimize the parameters of fuzzy controller. The discarding rate of data packet is calculated by fuzzy reasoning. The fuzzy control of queue scheduling is realized by using the congestion control method of the combination of global primary queue and local queue. According to the algorithm of fuzzy control, this paper puts forward a method of building fuzzy control algorithm by using the conventional function module of decentralized control system. This method provides a new idea for the better application of fuzzy control in decentralized control system.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Interior Design Digital Effect Drawing Production System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of digital design in interior design teaching. Firstly, a new interior design scheme is realized by using AutoCAD technology. Establish the concept of interior design and the overall design scheme of the building. The article chooses the type of light and material. Secondly, discrete design method is used to realize the interior scene layout. Finally, the parameters of color level and contrast are set to obtain the size of the image. Experiments show that this new technology can effectively reduce the time of each process in production. This system can effectively improve the speed of design.

articleTitle: Study on Occupant Damage Analysis and Reliability Optimization under AEB and Active Seat Belt
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: AEB Chinese name for automatic emergency braking, is currently a vehicle safety protection device, and the air bag the same role. With the rapid development of our country’ s social economy, the living standard of our people is constantly improving. At present, every family basically owns a car, which causes great traffic pressure in the city, it also increases the probability of traffic accident, and AEB as a kind of vehicle safety protection device, the research on vehicle safety and personnel protection is concerned by the community. However, when an unavoidable collision occurs, the AEB safety protection device will, to a certain extent, cause a change in the posture of the driver or passenger of the vehicle, which will affect the protection function of the restraint system, therefore, in order to effectively prevent vehicle drivers and passengers in the accident occurred during the posture changes, the active seat belt appeared. Based on this, in order to further improve the safety factor of driver and passenger of the restraint system, and effectively realize the maximum safety performance of the restraint system, in this paper, the occupant damage caused by AEB and active seat belt is analyzed, and its reliability is studied.

articleTitle: Theory and Simulation of Thermal Field of AC Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, the power supply reliability of high-voltage cable lines is a technical hotspot and difficulty that is closely watched in the world. The effect of cable thermal field is an important factor causing defects and failures, so a comprehensive analysis of it is an important part of monitoring and diagnosis. In this paper, the cable thermal field is firstly modeled through theoretical analysis. Secondly, the calculation theory and influencing factors of cable ampacity are analyzed, and then its calculation formulas under various working conditions are given. Finally, a simulation model is established to verify the theory. The non-contact online diagnosis of cable core temperature is realized, which is helpful for early detection of early hidden dangers of cables and comprehensively improves the power supply reliability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Thermal Machinery Fatigue Loading Model of Composite Materials Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to build a thermal machinery fatigue loading model of composite materials based on deep neural network and simulate it. In this article, CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) in DL (Deep Learning) technology are combined to establish a complete thermal machinery fatigue loading model of composite materials, and a large quantity of thermal machinery fatigue loading data of composite materials are trained and optimized. The simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of the proposed algorithm is higher than 10% compared with the traditional CNN algorithm and the traditional RNN algorithm. And the actual results are in good agreement with the simulation results, which verifies the reliability of the model. Based on the deep neural network algorithm, the nonlinear mapping of thermal machinery fatigue loading data of composite materials can be realized. The model can predict and evaluate the thermal machinery fatigue behavior of composites, and provide theoretical support and practical guidance for optimizing the design and service performance of composites. In addition, the model has strong generalization ability, and can be applied to the prediction of thermal machinery fatigue loading of different service environments and different types of composites.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Predictive Response Based on Time Series Forecast Model LSTM in Broadband High Current Feedback Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: For the wide-band large current feedback regulation system, accurate forecast technology is the key to realize efficient and stable control. In this article, the performance optimization of the broadband large current feedback regulation system is studied, and a forecast model and feedback control strategy based on long-term and short-term memory network (LSTM) are proposed, aiming at improving the simulation running time and forecast precision of the system and reducing the false alarm rate. Through experimental verification, it is found that the improved system has obvious advantages in simulation running time and forecast precision. Compared with the traditional regulation methods and forecast models, the new method can better adapt to the complex and dynamic broadband large current feedback regulation environment and improve the stability and reliability of the system. In addition, the false alarm rate of the improved system has been effectively reduced, thus reducing the time and cost of system maintenance and repair. This research provides a new theory and method for the optimal design and control of the broadband large current feedback regulation system, and provides an important technical support and theoretical basis for promoting the development and application of the broadband large current feedback regulation system. In addition, this research can also provide useful reference and enlightenment for the optimization of other industrial process control systems, and is of great significance for promoting scientific and technological progress in the field of industrial process control.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Enterprise Order Production Management System Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, the role of informatization in promoting enterprise development has gradually been recognized by enterprises, and the demand for information management systems is becoming increasingly urgent. In this regard, this article optimizes and designs the enterprise order production management system based on the improved ACA (Ant Colony Algorithm). The optimized order management system should have sufficient storage capacity to meet the needs of daily data changes in the company; In addition, there is a certain level of management for operating users, and different permissions can be assigned to different users. Finally, in the simulation experiment, the improved ACA in this paper was compared with three algorithms. The research results showed that the improved ACA in this paper only completed convergence in about 120 iterations, while AGA (Adaptive Genetic Algorithm) needed 200 iterations to complete convergence, GA (Genetic Algorithm) needed 160 iterations to complete convergence, and CF (Collaborative Filtering) needed 170 iterations to complete convergence. It can be seen that the improvement of ACA in this article greatly improves the convergence speed. By improving ACA, objects and the classes and resources they rely on can be effectively separated and decoupled, avoiding manual instantiation of objects in the program. This ensures that the program does not affect other code when modifying or adding modification functions in secondary development, and improves the maintainability of the code.

articleTitle: Study of One-stop Intelligent Teaching Platform for College English Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information construction in colleges and universities and the rapid popularization of mobile terminals, traditional digital campus applications face challenges in providing real-time access to information and mobility for users. This paper presents a study on the implementation of a one-stop service platform for smart campuses based on mobile terminals. The platform integrates smart classroom technology with college English (CE) and speaking classes, showcasing its advantages in CE listening and speaking instruction. The article analyzes the transformation of artificial intelligence in CE teaching within the context of big data. The research objective is to develop an understanding of the multi-level and multi-faceted needs of front-line teachers and students in CE teaching. The findings emphasize the importance of adapting to changes in teaching methods and highlight the direction of future CE teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the Siting of Base Stations under Different Coverage Modes
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: There an area. In this paper, we consider the site selection problem under two base station coverage modes. If the base station coverage area is a prototype, we plan to build 16 macro base stations and 2,763 micro base stations in the target area at a cost of 35.75 million yuan, covering $90.513 \%$ of the service volume. If the base station coverage area is three sectors, we plan to build 35 macro base stations and 3225 micro base stations in the target area at a cost of 35.75 million yuan, covering $90.401 \%$ of the service volume. The results show that the base station covers better in a circular way.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Power Supply Performance Optimization Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the continuous development and expansion of power supply systems, improving the performance of power supply has become an important challenge. This paper proposes a power supply performance optimization model based on deep learning to improve the efficiency and reliability of power supply systems. First, we use convolutional neural networks (CNN) and image processing (DP) to train and model the data. Then, by learning patterns and trends in the data, we are able to predict future supply needs and optimize scheduling and operational strategies for the power supply system. In addition, we have improved a graph roll algorithm (NDP) for the effect and improvement space of the power supply system through CNN and DP. Through experiments and analysis, we verify the validity and feasibility of the model. The results show that the power supply performance optimization model based on deep learning can significantly improve the efficiency and reliability of the power supply system, and reduce energy waste and cost. This study provides a new idea and method for the optimization and improvement of power supply system, which is of great significance for the realization of sustainable development, energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Study of Nucleic Acid Detection Model Based on Optimal Mixed Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the optimal number of mixed samples and the length of testing for a region of the new crown epidemic. In this paper, we consider a variety of factors to establish a model and give conclusions and recommendations on issues related to nucleic acid testing for the new crown epidemic. First, the mathematical model of sample pool counting is established, and the infection rate, mixed sample size, and total number of samples are set as variables, and the equation relationship between the three is established to calculate the average expected number of tests per sample, using the value for simple mathematical operations. Then the model is solved by bringing different infection rates into the equation to obtain the relationship between the infection rate and the total number of reagent tests. Finally, this paper constructs a mathematical expectation model for this, and transforms the problem into finding the minimal value of the mathematical expectation $E(X)$ to obtain the corresponding stem of the infection probability and the mixed sample size. And on this basis, the mathematical expectation model and the sample pool counting model established in this paper are combined to derive the total time of three rounds of nucleic acid testing.

articleTitle: Optimization Control of Construction Engineering Management Projects Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Construction projects generally have the characteristics of large scale, many construction processes and complicated handover, and all these links may have a certain impact on the quality of engineering construction. For the traditional construction project management, the management efficiency and management level are generally low, because the open management mode applied in it will lead to a series of problems. In this paper, DL (Deep learning) algorithm is applied to the optimal control of construction project management, and the whole process cost control strategy of construction project based on DNN (Deep neural network) is constructed, so as to accurately calculate the project budget, realize the dynamic management of the whole construction process, and further promote the sustainable development of construction enterprises. Managers should strictly control all links, accurately calculate the project budget, and achieve the goal of cost control in the whole process of construction projects. At the same time, it is necessary to strengthen the comprehensive management of construction projects, reasonably control the project cost, enhance the economic benefits of the construction industry, and ensure the healthy and stable development of the construction industry.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Multi-objective Optimization Non-dominant Individual Selection Strategy Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As one of the important components of the Internet of Things (IoT), wireless sensor networks (WSN) are widely deployed to monitor, perceive and collect object information in real time, and then collect the information to the control center of IoT for various analysis and decision-making. In order to improve the positioning accuracy of node positioning technology and obtain a more balanced unloading decision, this paper studies the constrained multi-objective evolution problem based on evolutionary algorithm, and puts forward the non-dominant individual selection strategy of evolutionary multi-objective optimization to solve the contradiction between delay and energy consumption in IoT computing unloading technology. By adopting different optimization strategies for each archive set, each archive set can achieve the optimal search efficiency and reduce unnecessary crossover and mutation of the algorithm. The simulation results show that compared with the original algorithm, the algorithm with adaptive partition strategy has improved the uniformity and breadth of the optimal solution. The algorithm makes up for the deficiency of the diversity of traditional non-dominated individual selection methods, makes full use of the structural information of antibodies, and greatly improves the diversity of Pareto solutions.

articleTitle: Rating and Evaluation Model Based on Grey Correlation Analysis and Time Series
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Nowadays, large-scale online markets are rapidly emerging, such as Tmall, Amazon and other online platforms, whose transaction value is up to several billion dollars. One of the most important principles of such a successful online shopping platform is the principle of customer obsession. Many platforms provide users with product rating opportunities, and users can give 1-5 points for products to reflect their satisfaction with this transaction. The large amount of data of these ratings provides a lot of useful information to be mined for decision makers. In this paper, a Rating and Evaluation Model Based on Grey Correlation Analysis and Time Series is put forward, Based on the product transaction information obtained through data mining, it first constructs an evaluation model of commodities based on the gray correlation analysis, three main consideration indicators are selected, namely, Comment, Rating value and Full-mark quantity, the corresponding weights are obtained in combination with the method of analytic hierarchy process, the gray weighted correlation degree of each commodity in a period of time is then calculated, which represents the degree of popularity of the commodity. Subsequently, the ARIMA model was also established by using time series tools to predict the grey weighted correlation of different commodities in the future, and the trend of the popularity of commodities in the future is also obtained. The overall trend of shopping and the popularity of commodities on Tmall shopping platform before and after the epidemic time are compared and analyzed, which is conducive to the further development of China’s online shopping platform from a statistical perspective.

articleTitle: Research on Grey Comprehensive Evaluation for Training Airspace Management Safety Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: To improve the safety level of military flight training, a safety evaluation method of airspace management is proposed. In this method, firstly, AHP and entropy method are used to calculate the comprehensive weight value of airspace management safety evaluation index of military flight training; Then, the grey comprehensive evaluation method is applied to evaluate the safety of airspace management of military flight training. The actual example indicates that the proposed method can evaluate the airspace management safety of military flight training, and can obtain correct and objective evaluation, thus verifying its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Transmission Line Deicing Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In view of the fact that high-voltage transmission lines in northern cities of China are prone to icing in winter, the traditional manual deicing is inefficient and dangerous. This paper proposes a power transmission line deicing robot using a six rotor UAV equipped with deicing device. The robot adopts mechanical deicing mode. When the end face of the deicing milling cutter contacts with the icing through the pitch adjustment system, the motor works, and then the icing on the wire is milled off. In addition, the distance adjustment system can adjust the distance between two milling cutters to adapt to different specifications of power transmission lines. Compared with the traditional deicing robot, the most important feature of the deicing robot is that it is combined with the UAV, which is convenient to manipulate and control the working position of the robot and the whole robot.In this paper, the deicing device, six rotor UAV, and deicing milling cutter of the deicing robot are first designed, and the three-dimensional model of the deicing robot is established using Solid Works software. Then the strength of the milling cutter, the key component of the deicing robot, is analyzed using ANSYS workbench software. The results show that the designed structures meet the strength requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Welding Process Parameters of Cast Aluminum Based on Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Aluminum alloy components are widely used in modern industrial manufacturing, but aluminum alloy materials have the defects of high thermal conductivity and fast dispersion speed. Friction spot welding is a new solid-state connection technology developed on the basis of friction stir welding. For 2 mm thick LY12 aluminum alloy, the orthogonal experimental design method is adopted. The process parameters of steam welding were optimized. The testing methods of solder joint quality of electronic components can be divided into non-destructive testing and destructive testing. With the development of modern industry and the improvement of automation, nondestructive testing is more and more widely used, which is an urgent requirement of the electronic industry. The extraction of solder joint features of electronic components is an important step in non-destructive testing. For the extraction of existing solder joint features of electronic components, it is highly dependent on the light source system, and the acquired image features are not obvious. A sample of solder joint shields for various defects. In order to really play its role, aluminum alloy components need to analyze and control the welding deformation. Therefore, it is of great significance to strengthen the research on the welding deformation of aluminum alloy components and propose the optimization of the welding process to improve my country’s welding technology and realize my country’s machinery manufacturing power.

articleTitle: Optimization Path Planning Algorithm Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization and the growth of traffic demand, traffic congestion has become more and more prominent. In the field of path planning, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) can effectively deal with the complex traffic environment and learn the optimal path selection strategy. This article aims to explore the optimal path planning algorithm based on DRL to improve the accuracy and efficiency of path planning. The algorithm estimates the state function by establishing a deep neural network, and uses reinforcement learning to optimize the strategy, so as to fully consider the actual traffic flow and provide accurate route suggestions for users. The experimental results show that the optimized path planning algorithm based on DRL has smaller path-finding error and higher path-finding accuracy. After many iterations, the routing accuracy of the algorithm can even reach more than 96%. Therefore, the optimized path planning algorithm based on DRL is an effective path planning method, which can deal with complex traffic scene information and optimize the path planning effect.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing Algorithms for Multiple Exchange Rate Linked Options Based on Data Statistical Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The breakthrough in option pricing emerged from the Black Scholes model in the early 1970s, marking the arrival of the era of financial engineering. Due to the increasingly complex economic environment, the assumptions of the Black Scholes pricing model are gradually not in line with the actual situation. Traditional option pricing models generally assume that the underlying asset price follows Geometric Brownian motion, which is a sufficient condition for market efficiency, but not a necessary condition. In this regard, this article conducted research on various pricing algorithms for exchange rate linked options based on statistical models. A market model was established from the perspectives of time parameters, multi-dimensions, and interest rate randomness, and various exchange rate linked options were analyzed. The results showed that the accuracy of all three algorithms was higher than 40%, while GA (Genetic Algorithm) and our algorithm had a higher relative accuracy of up to 80%. In the test of error rate, the error value of CF (Collaborative Filtering) is in a high state, reaching 0.45, followed by GA with an error value of 0.16, and the algorithm in this paper performs best with only 0.07. It can be seen that the algorithm in this paper is more suitable for calculating the value of a small number of options, and the finite difference method is more efficient when calculating the value of a large number of options.

articleTitle: Model Research on Forecast of Second-Hand House Price in Shenyang Based on XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In order to have a deep understanding of second-hand house prices in Shenyang, this paper studied transaction data of second-hand housing from the platform ke.com. First, the qualified data was determined and collected, then processed and data parameters were set. Second, by comparing three models, Ridge regression, Lasso Regression, and XGBoot model to find which is the best model to be used in the second-hand housing market. By implementing the data and analysis with visualization graphics, the study results indicate that the XGBoost model offers more accurate predictions in understanding second-hand housing prices in Shenyang.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design of Instructional Assessment System in Higher Vocational Schools Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As educational informatization experiences rapid expansion, its widespread integration in various facets of tertiary education has yielded commendable outcomes, but the research and practice of measuring instructional level in instructional level assessment system and assessment model are relatively backward. Scientific and effective instructional level assessment methods play an important role in giving full play to the guiding and inspiring role in the instructional stage and urging teachers to improve their instructional level. Data analysis, achieved through the utilization of data mining tools, involves the identification of meaningful, prospective, and comprehensible patterns within datasets. Ensuring and enhancing the quality of hands-on instruction, as well as conducting judicious evaluations of practical teaching, has emerged as a crucial focal point in teaching management. Therefore, using artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm to analyze the data of instructional assessment can effectively improve the instructional level of vocational schools. In this article, an improved algorithm of instructional level assessment in vocational schools is proposed by combining the individual optimal selection of genetic algorithm (GA) and the nonlinear fitting characteristics of back propagation neural network (BPNN).

articleTitle: Simplified Algorithm for Seismic Action of High-rise Building Structures Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: At present, the seismic fortification level of “small earthquake is not bad, medium earthquake can be repaired, and big earthquake can not fall” adopted by various countries is to ensure life safety as the single fortification goal. The structure of high-rise building is complex, and the degree of freedom is huge. When the active seismic control method is adopted, the accurate model of the structure cannot be established, and the overall control target is difficult to obtain. Constructing a deep learning unsupervised feature learning network model suitable for seismic data is conducive to extracting gas bearing response features. Seismic data are real-valued data and have continuity in time and space. Combining with the characteristics of seismic data, this paper introduces a continuous limited Boltzmann machine that simulates the probability distribution of continuous data as a shallow model for deep networks. The basic idea of performance-based design is to make the designed engineering structure meet all kinds of predetermined performance target requirements during use, and the specific performance requirements can be determined according to the importance of buildings and structures. Different from traditional machine learning algorithms, deep learning has three learning methods: supervised learning, unsupervised learning and semi-supervised learning. The influence of high-rise building’s vibration mode is usually considered by the vibration mode decomposition method. This paper is based on the algorithm simplification of the seismic action of high-rise building structures, so as to simplify the calculation process and optimize the accurate location of the maximum seismic action point of high-rise building structures.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Data Storage Method Based on Multiple Data Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper studies a distribution network data storage method based on multiple data sources, which is based on multiple data sources and realizes the storage function of multiple data sources through data acquisition, analysis, storage, encryption and iteration. Obtain data based on multiple data sources, analyze multiple types of data, store multiple types of data in a unified format, encrypt data with encryption algorithm, and finally iterate the updated data. This complete set of services accurately, efficiently and safely completes the storage of data from multiple data sources.

articleTitle: Fast Capture Analysis of Beidou C_(B2I) Code Based on Segment Folding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Satellite navigation technology is widely used in transportation, logistics, agriculture, aerospace, land security, land planning, basic surveying and mapping, geological and earthquake disaster monitoring, etc. Because of its special technical significance, China must vigorously develop Beidou satellite navigation technology in order to avoid being controlled by others and ensure national security. Because the search and acquisition time of satellite signal (SS) determines the performance of GPS / BeiDou receiver, it has always been the primary topic of satellite navigation technology research to acquire SSs quickly and accurately. This paper presents a segmented folding algorithm (SFA) based on Beidou C_ (b2i) code as the research object, the Beidou C_ (b2i) code fast acquisition (FA) analysis. The principle of acquisition system and Beidou C are discussed_ (b2i) code SS acquisition method; The frame flow chart and algorithm formula of the SFA are listed. Finally, the effectiveness of the segmented folding acquisition algorithm proposed in this paper is verified by simulation experiments and performance analysis, which is very helpful to improve the acquisition rate.

articleTitle: Simulation of Annual Investment Forecast of Power Grid Infrastructure Construction Based on Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Driven by the steady and good development trend of economic operation, the social power consumption is also growing, and a stable grid structure is an important guarantee to ensure power supply. In order to meet the demand, the power grid construction task increases year by year, and the investment scale also increases year by year.
