However, under the influence of the national macroeconomic situation, large-scale investment will make power grid companies face huge operating pressure, especially in terms of economic benefits. How to formulate scientific and reasonable investment scale prediction and distribution mode to avoid inefficient and ineffective investment is of great significance for power supply companies to make investment planning, and also provides theoretical and methodological support for optimizing the distribution of power grid construction funds. This paper takes data mining as a means and takes the power grid investment demand forecasting model as the research object, and proposes a new power grid investment demand forecasting model based on data mining. By means of data mining, this paper puts forward a new power grid investment demand forecasting model, and the simulation results show that the average relative error compared with other forecasting models is increased by 1.88%, which proves the effectiveness, applicability and superiority of the proposed model for power grid investment demand forecasting, and provides a new method for power grid investment forecasting.

articleTitle: Overview of Battlefield Debris Data Fusion Technology for Situation Awareness
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The rapid growth of debris data acquisition ability and limited data understanding ability in military battlefield do not match, which seriously restricts the development of situation awareness; Based on the analysis of the source, type and information interaction relationship of battlefield debris data, this paper analyzes the representation dimension, display granularity and update frequency factors that affect battlefield situation awareness from the technical level, and uses data fusion and mining technology based on knowledge map to build the association map of battlefield situation, so as to improve the intelligent recognition and processing level of battlefield debris data, It provides technical support for big data mining of situation intelligent awareness.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Terrace Restoration Sampling Governance Model Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The Honghe Hani terraces are famous ancient terraces in China, and this paper takes the Honghe Hani terrace ecosystem as the research object. The ability of the Honghe Hani terraces to maintain increased yields despite the once-in-a-century drought is inextricably linked to the perfect operation of the local rice terrace ecosystem. The three-dimensional terrace ecosystem is composed of four elements: forest, ditch (water system), village and terrace, and the long-term stability of the ecosystem is maintained by the water connotation function of forest, irrigation and drainage function of ditch, control and distribution function of village and agricultural production function of terrace. In this paper, we use fuzzy clustering algorithm (FCA) to calculate the mean value of farmers’ participation in terrace restoration and management behavior in each ecosystem from the perspective of “four elements homogeneous” ecosystem, and then compare the trust of Hani farmers in the “four elements homogeneous” ecosystem to the trust of villagers in their own tribe in terrace restoration and management behavior. Then, we compared the trust of Hani farmers in the terrace restoration and management behaviors, and analyzed the characteristics of the terrace restoration and management behaviors, so that Hani farmers can creatively realize the autonomous management of the terrace ecosystem from various aspects.

articleTitle: Construction of College English Network Communication Platform Based on Java Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: This paper uses JSP technology developed based on Java and with good platform scalability. This system has the characteristics of easy maintenance and easy expansion. It puts forward the design and development ideas of interactive dynamic communication website to solve the problems of traditional communication methods. According to the actual situation of interactive dynamic communication website, carry out demand analysis and feasibility analysis. Use the principle of Java technology to build the multimedia remote information platform, start with the connection between the security monitoring part of the multimedia remote information platform and the server and passenger plane, break the traditional method, study the key principle and function of Java technology, and design the multimedia remote information security monitoring platform, The data are analyzed through experiments to find the most suitable platform to ensure the security of remote network communication, so as to ensure the security of multimedia remote data and information.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Power Supply Aerial Work Equipment Loading Device Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss and study the design of the control system of the power supply aerial work equipment loading device based on intelligent algorithm. The realization method of CAN bus control system of aerial work platform is designed by using ARM9 embedded controller. The structure of the whole system allows the control, monitoring and communication of power supply aerial work instruments. The corresponding controller is designed to make the manipulator track the expected trajectory effectively. The adaptive control strategy based on neural network is used to design the controller of the manipulator system. Neural network can fit the unknown model of the system well and adjust the output of the controller adaptively to achieve the ideal control effect. The research results show that the neural network is feasible for the vibration control of uncertain flexible manipulator with input dead zone, and a satisfactory control effect can be obtained.

articleTitle: Simulation of Financial Risk Assessment Model for Listed Companies Based on Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the context of global economic integration, listed companies are facing increasingly complex financial risks. In order to accurately predict and evaluate these risks, this study proposes a financial risk assessment model based on DM (Data Mining) algorithm and verifies it in a simulation environment. In the model construction phase, this study compared various DM algorithms, such as decision trees, neural networks, and SVM (Support Vector Machine), and ultimately selected the algorithm with the best performance for risk assessment. The simulation experimental results confirm that the training time of the model in this paper is lower than that of the SVM risk assessment model, with an average training time of 0.046S, indicating that the model in this paper improves the algorithm efficiency. However, the stage of SVM judgment requires calculating the distance formula, which incurs additional calculation time, with an average training time of 0.053S. Therefore, the overall test results are higher than the training time of the model in this paper. Overall, this study provides an advanced and efficient financial risk assessment tool for listed companies and investors, which is expected to play an important role in actual risk management and investment decision-making.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Pole Climbing Behavior Detection and Alarm System Based on Moving Target Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the power industry, pole climbing is a common dangerous behavior, which may lead to serious safety accidents if it is not stopped. The purpose of this article is to study the application of moving target detection algorithm based on deep learning algorithm in pole climbing behavior detection and alarm. In this article, a moving target detection algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) is proposed, which improves the accuracy and real-time performance of target detection in video surveillance, and then realizes intelligent detection and alarm of pole climbing behavior. Finally, the feasibility and superiority of the optimized algorithm are verified by experiments. The results show that the model based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) and GAN can gradually converge in the training process, and the loss value of the generator is low, and the accuracy and recall rate are high, which is more than 20% higher than that of the behavior detection algorithm based on Support Vector Machine (SVM). The system realizes the function of target detection and real-time early warning, and has good real-time and robustness. The moving target detection algorithm based on DBN has a good application prospect in pole climbing behavior detection and alarm, and can provide a more accurate and real-time solution for the intelligent video surveillance field.

articleTitle: Optimization of English Vocabulary Machine Translation Algorithm Based on Pruning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As the carrier of information, the importance of translation between different languages is increasing day by day. Pruning strategy keeps the cost of machine translation system within an acceptable range. At the same time, pruning strategy is also one of the important factors affecting translation quality. Pruning can simplify complexity and sentences, and make people grasp the meaning of sentences correctly and quickly. Machine translation is an important branch of natural language processing, which refers to the process of automatically translating one natural language into another with the help of a computer. On the basis of deeply studying the search space of frequent pattern mining algorithm and carefully analyzing the existing pruning strategies, this paper proposes a new pruning strategy of search space SEP and IEP. Experimental results on large-scale data show that the translation optimization technology proposed in this paper can reduce the search error of decoding to a certain extent and improve the translation performance of phrase-based statistical machine translation system.

articleTitle: Construction of Music Curriculum Resource Management System Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Strengthening university students’ cultural quality education is a necessary condition for the country to cultivate all-round high-quality talents, and improving university students’ scientific and cultural quality in an all-round way is inseparable from the effective development and utilization of curriculum resources. Therefore, relevant personnel should make use of the integration of music curriculum resources to continuously improve the quality of music teaching. This article discusses how to develop music curriculum resources, and proposes and constructs a personalized music curriculum resource management system. Based on CF (Collaborative filtering) algorithm, the system can recommend instructional resources that users may be interested in according to their browsing records, browsing habits and preferences. Finally, the proposed algorithm is compared with other algorithms on related data sets. The test results show that the RMSE of this algorithm is low, which is 0.525, and the recall and F1 value are at a high level, which can reach more than 94%. It is hoped that this research can effectively broaden students’ musical horizons and make students truly develop their musical literacy in the stage of innovation in music teaching.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data Information Processing Technology in the Operation and Accounting System of Enterprise Accounting Fund
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Based on the theory of process reengineering and internal control combined with the latest RPA and OCR technology, this paper optimizes and reconstructs the intelligent account reimbursement system, intelligent budget system, interactive communication platform and financial sharing system. The system uses SAP HANA view modeling to construct real-time analysis model. In this way, enterprises can meet the real-time data analysis requirements. Finally, the financial early warning model is constructed by data mining algorithm. This helps enterprises identify and reduce financial risks. You find that the intelligent system can realize the electronation of financial data and paperless vouchers. This system can improve the efficiency of financial work and promote the sharing and integration of resources.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an English Teaching Corpus Management System Based on C/S Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the traditional classroom teaching mode can no longer meet the learning needs of students, and the application of Internet and computer technology has become an important way to improve the teaching effect. Traditional English teaching corpus can’t be updated in time, and it is difficult to keep up with the ever-changing modern language changes and popular topics. As a result, students may not be able to obtain the latest and true language materials, which makes their language expression ability not match the real scene. The traditional corpus teaching method is relatively traditional, lacking diversity and interaction, and can not effectively cultivate students’ language application ability and communication ability. In order to meet the needs of students for English learning, educational institutions and schools have introduced English teaching corpora in C/S environment to provide more convenient and efficient learning methods. This paper proposes an English teaching corpus management system based on C/S environment, through which students can access the corpus anytime and anywhere to obtain the required learning materials and resources. Experiments show that the English teaching corpus management system based on C/S environment can enrich the teaching content, provide diversified learning resources and help students improve their English listening, speaking, reading and writing abilities.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application and Development of Intelligent Monitoring Technology of Clean Energy Safe Power Generation Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: As the population continues to grow, the issue of safe power generation from clean energy sources plays an increasingly important role in our surroundings. This paper outlines the basic concepts of computer vision and introduces the application and development of computer vision in the intelligent monitoring technology of clean energy safe power generation. By analyzing the application of artificial energy in wind power generation, hydro power generation, nuclear power generation and photovoltaic power generation, the results show that computer vision technology can monitor clean energy generation equipment in real time, shorten troubleshooting time, and has a broad application prospect in clean energy safe power generation.

articleTitle: Construction of a Transmission Line Maintenance System Based on Machine Learning Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The transmission line is an important component of the power system, undertaking the key task of energy transmission. When there is an operational fault in the transmission line, it will have a negative impact on the entire power system, and not only that, but also the quality of power supply will be greatly reduced. Therefore, its safe and stable operation is a prerequisite for the normal operation of the entire power system. Considering that the different localization results of existing transmission line fault localization algorithms affect the fast recovery problem of power systems based on faults, this paper constructs a transmission line maintenance system optimized based on machine learning algorithms. Construct a machine learning based NFA model based on real-time monitoring, operation, and historical fault repair times of equipment to distinguish subtle defects of different types of transmission lines; Process the brightness, contrast, stitching method, and other aspects of the image, and finally achieve intelligent detection of subtle defects in transmission lines based on machine learning by calculating the phase grouping gradient. The experimental results show that the system proposed in this paper can better detect fault signals of transmission lines compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Optimization of County-Level Highway Construction Organization Network Resources Based on Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In order to scientifically solve the comprehensive optimization problem of highway construction project network plan, aiming at the problems and deficiencies existing in the traditional highway construction network map optimization, this paper uses heuristic search algorithm and genetic algorithm to optimize and adjust the network plan of highway construction network optimization from three aspects of time, cost and resources, and establishes the corresponding mathematical model, At the same time, for the first time, from the perspective of the maximum benefit of highway engineering project, this paper attempts to comprehensively optimize the network diagram by considering three factors of time, cost and resources, establishes the corresponding mathematical model, and gives the specific solution method. Starting from the research on the geographical characteristics of Yuncheng City, integrating regional highway resources, this paper makes a beneficial discussion on the optimization of the network, level and cycle of township and organic villages connecting county and township roads, so as to improve the overall service level of the highway network to rural areas, so as to achieve the goal of township connecting class II and county-level roads, and organic villages connecting class IV and township-level roads.

articleTitle: Two-degree-of-freedom Flutter Wing Aerodynamic Characteristics Analysis Based on Fluent
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In the study of bionic flutter vehicles, the fluttering wing is the main source of thrust and lift of the vehicles. However, since the research on low Reynolds numbers related to bionic flutter vehicles is still in its early stage, the research on the aerodynamic characteristics of flutter vehicle is mainly through computational fluid dynamics and wind tunnel tests. Most of the studies on the wing lift characteristics of flutter aircraft through computational fluid dynamics are focused on two-dimensional airfoils and three-dimensional single-degreeof-freedom flutter wings. In this paper, the effect of three different flutter parameters on the aerodynamic performance of the bionic flutter aircraft is analyzed by using the computational fluid dynamics software Fluent to solve the N-S equation. It is shown that the phase difference of flutter, the frequency of flutter, and the amplitude of flutter all have a large effect on the lift coefficient, which provides a theoretical basis for the subsequent research of flutter aircraft.

articleTitle: Implementation of Mental Medical Registration Algorithm Based on Psychopathology Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Psychopathology also refers to psychopathology, which is a scientific study of various psychological disorders. Strictly speaking, the research fields it involves include psychologists, psychiatrists, neuroscientists, endocrinologists and pharmacologists, which are different from the medical practice of clinical psychologists and psychiatrists who treat psychological disorders. In this paper, we propose a mental medical registration algorithm based on psychopathology model, which sets the search direction as the initial orthogonal search direction again after every complete update of the search direction. The experiment shows that the registration algorithm in this paper only needs about 150 iterations to reach the optimal solution, while the genetic algorithm needs 210 times. The experimental data fully show that the registration algorithm has a good global search ability, and has achieved good results. The registration technology is used to fuse the image information obtained under different conditions, integrate the advantages of various imaging devices, and express the patient’s mental information as much as possible in psychopathology, becoming a strong backing for clinical medical observation, diagnosis and treatment of boils in psychiatry.

articleTitle: Knowledge Map Construction of Power Marketing Business Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid growth of modern society, the demand for electric power in society has increased by a large margin. Under the new environment, the forms and categories of marketing information of electric power enterprises are diversified. With the establishment and change of electricity market environment, some conventional marketing strategies are difficult to achieve the best marketing effect. In this paper, the knowledge map of electric power marketing business based on machine learning algorithm is proposed, so as to promote the establishment of electric power marketing decision support model. Through an example, the evaluation method of this model is introduced, and finally the feasibility of using this model is obtained. Under the new mode, the marketing information of electric power enterprises presents diversified characteristics in form, category and other properties, and marketing analysis and evaluation involves the mutual conversion of qualitative and quantitative data and natural language description. The electric power marketing analysis based on the model of qualitative and quantitative data conversion and taking into account the uncertainty of the object is more in line with the human cognitive model, and it can more objectively and truly reflect the nature of the object, thus realizing the accurate evaluation of the state of electric power marketing.

articleTitle: Research on Smart City Construction Based on Internet of Things and New Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: With the updating of network information, the Internet of Things and new media technologies have become rapidly developing high-tech. They are a new information technology turning point on the basis of computer Internet and mobile communication technology. Internet of Things technology can accurately study and analyze the data of middle and high cities in modern cities so as to satisfy people’s demand for information and data as much as possible. New media technologies accelerate the speed of information dissemination, improve people’s quality of life, and create a new service mode has accelerated the pace of urbanization and laid a solid foundation for the construction of a smart city.

articleTitle: Strengthening Teaching and Learning Based Multi-population Symbiotic Organism Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: A Strengthening Teaching and Learning based Multi-population Symbiotic Organism Search algorithm (STLMSOS) is proposed to address the shortcomings of the symbiotic biological algorithm in solving complex high-dimensional problems, such as low accuracy, poor diversity and the tendency to fall into local optimality. The algorithm divides the ecosystem into three populations based on the evolutionary characteristics of organisms, and draws on the powerful search capability of the “teaching” phase and the excellent search capability of the “learning” phase of the teaching optimization algorithm, so that the mutualism population and commensalism population can evolve in stages, enhancing the solution accuracy and diversity of the algorithm. At the same time, by taking into account the complex connection between biological migration and species evolution, the information interaction between multiple populations is improved so that stagnant populations can interact in time to jump out of the local optimum. The proposed STLMSOS was fully evaluated on the CEC2017 problem set, and the simulation results show that STMSOS outperforms other state-of-the-art algorithms and is an effective algorithm for solving complex high-dimensional problems.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Coal Mine Electrical Automation System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The development of computer technology promotes the play of intelligent technology; In the context of today’s time, computer technology and intelligent technology have been applied to various fields of the industry from many aspects to promote the improvement of enterprise production efficiency. At the same time, with the rapid development of China’s social economy, the country’s energy requirements are getting higher and higher, and the demand for coal is gradually increasing. Coal mining enterprises should actively regulate coal mining technology to improve coal mining efficiency. The coal mining industry is a high-risk industry with many influencing factors. Therefore, coal mining enterprises should effectively use the existing intelligent technology and give full play to the advantages of electrical automation control systems to improve coal mining efficiency and reduce the probability of various potential dangers.

articleTitle: Research on the Technical Route of Electrical Highway
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The truck electrical highway technology has advantages in energy saving, carbon reduction and freight cost reduction in specific scenarios, and has been listed as an important forward-looking direction by many countries. the progress of different technical routes of freight commercial vehicles are investigated.The cost economy, the environmental and social benefits of carbon reduction and emission reduction of different technical routes of freight commercial vehicles are analyzed to provides a reference for enterprises to look forward to the technical layout, and to support the formulation of relevant policies and standards in the future.

articleTitle: Evaluation of an Improved Algorithm Based on SPRP-AHP
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous iteration of evaluation methods, it is particularly important to propose a new type of evaluation algorithm. This paper first based on the preevaluation analysis of statement preference (SP) and reveal preference (RP) survey, and constructs an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) model to evaluate the effect optimization, which has the optimization compared with the conventional model. Using certain case data for analysis, it can be found that: (1) the improved evaluation model proposed in this paper has a good degree of proximity (2) the improved algorithm solves the problem of evaluating parking charging policy.

articleTitle: Design of Enterprise Financial Early Warning Model Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: In an increasingly competitive market economy, business operations are faced with more and more uncertainty. It has become an important part of enterprise financial management to build a financial crisis early warning system suitable for the actual situation of the enterprise to help the enterprise prevent and resolve financial crisis. Establishing and implementing an early warning system for corporate financial crisis is a natural choice for financial management system innovation. With the changes in the international market environment, the risks faced by enterprises are gradually increasing. How to effectively avoid financial risks and establish a set of financial crisis early warning systems suitable for them has become one of the important research directions of modern enterprises. The method used in this article is python, whose programming language is flexible and powerful. The biggest feature is that the code is concise and neat, elegant and clean, and has a very rich cross-platform standard library and third-party library. Python has fewer keywords, and the indented format not only brings convenience to reading, but also facilitates further revision and revision of the program.

articleTitle: Simulation of Power Grid Investment Decision Evaluation Model Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Power grid is an important infrastructure industry and public utility to ensure national economic development, social harmony and stability, and improve people’s quality of life. Its development has always been paid attention to. As an important facility to directly transmit electric energy to users, the investment in distribution network is increasing. However, the difference of regional distribution network development and the imbalance of economic development have caused some difficulties in the investment decision of distribution network. Due to the wide business scope, many participating departments and large amount of participating data, there are many problems in the current power grid investment(PGI) evaluation activities, such as inaccurate evaluation results, no unified evaluation model, complicated evaluation calculation process, a large amount of manpower and material resources, etc. Based on the traditional genetic algorithm, the constraint conditions of combination forecasting are optimized and the crossover operator and mutation operator in genetic algorithm are improved, so that the algorithm has stronger global search ability and convergence ability. This topic has summarized and studied the characteristics of PGI. On the basis of fully investigating the current investment evaluation scheme of power grid enterprises, the results of using the proposed combination prediction model to predict the PGI in a certain region show that, compared with the single prediction model and the other two combination prediction models, the proposed combination prediction model can make full use of the information of the original data and has higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Provincial Grid Emission Factors Considering Clean Energy Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The power industry is the largest carbon emission department in China, and the accurate calculation and assessment of grid carbon emissions is the basis for achieving its carbon emission reduction. At present, the carbon emission accounting of the power industry is mostly based on the average emission factor (AEF), which has issues of poor timeliness and large error. Therefore, the calculation method of marginal emission factor (MEF) of provincial power grid is proposed. The MEF considers clean energy power generation, time, climate and other factors, which can characterize the dynamic relationship between power generation and carbon emissions in different periods of time, and provide method support for carbon emission analysis and reduction path of power system. Based on the energy consumption data of provincial power system, the mathematical model of MEF is derived. On this basis, the MEF of Sichuan power grid from 2011 to 2020 is calculated, and the change trend of MEF and its influencing factors are analyzed to provide a new method for calculating the emission factors of China’s power grid.

articleTitle: Impedance Matching and Optimal Design of Multilayer Nano-absorbing Coatings Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: The wide application of stealth technology in today’s military field has had a significant impact on the development of national defense in various countries. The research and development of high-performance microwave absorbing materials has become a major topic in the field of military technology in various countries. Nano materials have become a hot spot in the research and development field of microwave absorbing materials because of their excellent microwave absorbing properties. The traditional microwave absorbing materials have heavy weight, large thickness and narrow absorbing frequency band, which can not meet the requirements of modern battlefield conditions for the stealth performance of weapons and equipment. Therefore, it is urgent to develop a new generation of microwave absorbing materials with “light weight, thin thickness, wide frequency band and strong absorption”. In recent years, some new wave absorbing materials have emerged, such as nano wave absorbing materials, chiral wave absorbing materials, polycrystalline iron fiber wave absorbing materials, plasma wave absorbing materials, intelligent wave absorbing materials and so on. Among them, nano absorbing materials have become the research hotspot of the new generation of absorbing materials because of their special absorbing mechanism and the advantages of light and thin. Now they are developing in the direction of multi-layer, composite and coating. This paper mainly starts from the basic theory of layered medium, based on the absorbing model, aiming at the optimization goal of “thin, light, wide and strong”, applying the power reflection formula of multilayer absorbing materials that satisfies the generalized matching law, combined with Numerical calculation of the actual material, using the tracking algorithm and frequency optiamization method to carry out the impedance matching of the relevant electromagnetic parameters of the selected nano-absorbing coating material and its optimization design. According to the optimized results and the experimental conditions, the corresponding single and double-layer nano-absorbing coatings were prepared, and the experimental coating samples were used to measure the absorption effect. The results show that the developed double-layer absorption materials have better absorption at the same time, the feasibility of computer optimization design simulation in this paper is verified. The research on impedance matching and optimal design of multilayer nano-wave absorbing coatings lays a foundation for the design of stealth materials and the preparation of coating materials, which has important theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Multi-Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Improved Yolo in Target Tracking and Detection of Unmanned Storage Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Software Engineering, Social Network Analysis and Intelligent Computing (SSAIC)
abstract: Due to the rapid advancement of industrial automation in recent years, unmanned storage equipment has found extensive applications in logistics and manufacturing. However, equipment tracking is still a key issue restricting production efficiency and safety. To tackle this challenge, the present study introduces an enhanced YOLO (You Only Look Once) based multi-target tracking algorithm. The algorithm aims to facilitate the tracking and detection of unmanned storage equipment. In this study, the basic principle and characteristics of YOLO algorithm are introduced first, and its efficient target detection ability is emphasized, and how to apply it to the field of multi-target tracking. Then, according to the characteristics of unmanned storage equipment, this study has improved on the basis of YOLO algorithm to adapt to the complex environment and changing target states. In addition to incorporating the spatial information of the target, the enhanced algorithm incorporates the historical motion information of the target. This integration enables more precise and stable target tracking by utilizing Kalman filtering and data cascade techniques. Extensive experiments are conducted in a real scenario of unmanned storage equipment to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Experimental results show that the improved YOLO multi-target tracking algorithm can track multiple moving targets efficiently and accurately under complex background. This algorithm not only significantly improves the recognition and prediction ability of device tracking, but also achieves important results in providing more accurate information of device operating status and location. In summary, based on the improved YOLO multi-target tracking algorithm, this study has achieved remarkable application effects in the target tracking and detection of unmanned storage equipment. This algorithm can not only improve the reliability and operation security of the equipment, but also provide users with more intuitive and visual equipment operating status and location information, and provide strong support for equipment management and scheduling. In the future, this multi-target tracking algorithm based on improved YOLO is expected to be widely promoted and applied in the field of industrial automation.
